jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Description**

**Real Estate, Planning, Design & Construction**

UCLA Health is one of the most advanced academic medical systems in the world, and the environments we build are as critical to our mission as the care delivered within them. We are seeking a Furniture, Fixtures & Equipment Project Coordinator to join our Real Estate, Planning, Design & Construction team, a professional who brings technical fluency in design and construction with the organizational discipline to drive projects from concept through closeout in one of healthcare's most complex and regulated environments.

In this role, you will independently manage small capital projects end-to-end while supporting Senior Project Managers with furniture and equipment on priority initiatives exceeding $1M. You will serve as a key liaison between contracted vendors, consultants, and UCLA Health clients, coordinating design, construction, FF&E procurement, regulatory compliance, and move planning across a dynamic portfolio of concurrent projects.

**In this role, you will:**

* Maintain and develop the PDC Resource Library, manage vendor relationships, vet new products, and support the department's Standardization Program
* Manage the full FF&E program, coordinating with clients, vendors, and manufacturers through procurement, delivery, installation, and punch list resolution
* Lead small capital projects through all phases, from scoping and design through plan check, bidding, construction, and fit-up/move-in, with full ownership of budgets, schedules, and client communication
* Navigate plan check and back-check processes through Campus Building Official and HCAI (OSHPD) approval, and manage all associated documentation and inspector visits
* Oversee construction activities including contractor schedules, pay applications, and utility and fire alarm shutdowns to maintain an operational facility
* Ensure all project closeout documentation, including warranties, record drawings, and O&M manuals, meets contract requirements and is transferred to the appropriate entity

**Salary Range:** $38.65 – $80.70 per hour.

**Target Salary Range: $39.00 - $45.00 per hour**

  
Pay range: $38.65 - $80.70 an hour  
  
**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 1 to 2 years of professional experience in design, construction, or FF&E
* Working knowledge of healthcare construction regulations including HCAI (OSHPD), California Building Code, Title 22, and ADA/accessibility standards
* Strong ability to manage multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities and deadlines
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with clinical, administrative, and vendor stakeholders

**Preferred**

* Experience managing projects within a healthcare or academic medical center environment
* Familiarity with UCLA standards, UCOP Capital Programs processes, and Job Order Contracting
* Experience with FF&E procurement and move coordination in a large institutional setting
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and/or Revit, and intermediate skills in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project) and Bluebeam

jobs.description:

**Work type:** Staff  
**Location:** Long Beach  
**Categories:** Confidential, Administrative, Temporary, Full Time

Join the vibrant community at California State University, Long Beach (CSULB)!

Located just three miles from the Pacific Ocean, CSULB offers an inspiring workplace and an exceptional Southern California lifestyle. Our 322-acre campus—one of the largest in the CSU system—serves more than 42,000 students and is known for its commitment to student success, innovation, and impactful academic and research initiatives.

As a member of the CSULB community, you’ll experience a dynamic environment filled with cultural landmarks, collaborative energy, and opportunities to make a meaningful difference.

Work-life balance thrives here. Long Beach blends coastal relaxation with urban vibrancy, offering miles of beaches, year-round sunshine, a thriving arts and food scene, and convenient access to both Los Angeles and Orange County. It’s an ideal place to grow your career while enjoying everything Southern California has to offer.

Join the California State University (CSU) and explore career opportunities that advance student success and strengthen California’s future—offering competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and professional growth.

jobs.title: Social Media Content Creator & Brand Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Social Media Content Creator & Brand Coordinator**

**Location:** Manhattan Beach, CA, with scheduled shoots throughout South Bay and Los Angeles  
**Schedule:** Part-time, approximately 20 hours per week  
**Pay:** $20–$25 per hour, depending on experience and portfolio

**About the Opportunity**

AMICO Salon and MICO Haircare are looking for a creative, organized person to help tell the stories behind our salon and our developing haircare brand.

You’ll work directly with founder and hairstylists and collaborate with our branding and social media team. Your main focus will be filming, photography, short-form editing, and coordinating the people and locations needed to produce strong content for both brands.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys beauty, hair, storytelling, and bringing creative ideas to life.

**What You’ll Do**

* Film and photograph hair transformations, styling tutorials, consultations, stylist interviews, product content, and behind-the-scenes moments.
* Capture founder journey and the process of building MICO Haircare.
* Edit short videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and other digital channels.
* Help recruit and schedule hair models, confirm shoot details, and coordinate participant permissions.
* Arrange shoots with stylists and participating salons, including locations outside AMICO.
* Research relevant beauty influencers and creators, conduct approved outreach, and track responses and follow-ups.
* Coordinate approved product gifting and creator content deadlines as programs develop.
* Follow creative briefs and shot lists while contributing fresh content ideas.
* Organize original footage, photos, and edited assets so our branding team can use them across social media, the website, and marketing campaigns.
* Provide light administrative support related to content production, scheduling, and brand coordination.

**How You’ll Work With Our Team**

Our branding and social media team will guide the creative direction and publishing calendar. You’ll help turn those plans into usable content through reliable coordination, filming, editing, and delivery.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Examples of short-form videos you personally filmed and edited.
* A strong eye for hair, beauty, lighting, composition, and visual storytelling.
* Confidence filming on a smartphone or camera and editing with CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with Instagram Reels and TikTok.
* Strong organization, communication, and follow-through.
* Comfort approaching models, stylists, salon owners, and creators professionally.
* Ability to work independently, take feedback, and meet deadlines.
* Based in South Bay or Los Angeles, with reliable transportation to scheduled work locations.

Beauty or salon experience, Canva skills, and experience coordinating shoots or creator partnerships are helpful. A strong portfolio and dependable work habits matter more than a specific degree.

**Work Schedule**

This role requires regular in-person work at our Manhattan Beach salon and scheduled location shoots. Weekly hours will include coordination, filming, travel between work locations, editing, and content organization.

**How to Apply**

Please submit:

* Your résumé or a brief summary of relevant experience.
* Three links to videos you personally filmed and edited, explaining your contribution.
* Your city and weekly availability.
* A short note about why you’d enjoy creating content for AMICO Salon and MICO Haircare.

Applications must include video examples to be considered.

Pay: $20.03 - $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Agency Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Konnect:**

Konnect Agency is an independent PR and communications agency helping brands build awareness, relevance, and momentum. Our work brings together earned media, creator partnerships, experiential marketing, social media, and compelling storytelling.

**The Opportunity:**

We're looking for a strong writer and highly organized Agency Marketing Coordinator to help bring Konnect's work, people, and perspective to a broader audience.

You'll connect the dots across our social channels, newsletter, website, award submissions, and marketing materials, making sure great work becomes compelling content and reaches the right audience.

Working with agency leadership and teams across the business, you'll gather stories, write copy, coordinate assets and approvals, and keep our marketing calendar moving. You should enjoy both finding the story and doing the follow-up needed to get it published.

**What You'll Do:**

**Write and develop content**

* Work with the social and digital teams to gather and help edit social posts, newsletters, website copy, agency announcements, case studies, and marketing materials.
* Turn campaign results, team insights, and agency milestones into clear, engaging stories.
* Support executive thought leadership by developing draft posts and articles from leadership's ideas.
* Adapt stories for different audiences and channels while maintaining a consistent Konnect voice.
* Check facts, results, names, and details before content goes live.

**Connect social, email, and website marketing**

* Maintain one editorial calendar across Konnect's marketing channels.
* Coordinate with social and creative colleagues to develop, approve, and publish content.
* Help produce the agency newsletter, including story selection, copywriting, asset collection, testing, and distribution.
* Keep website news, case studies, and team information current.
* Extend the life of strong content: turn a campaign success into a case study, newsletter feature, social series, and award opportunity.

**Coordinate awards and industry visibility**

* Research relevant agency, campaign, and leadership awards.
* Maintain a calendar of deadlines, requirements, entry fees, and submission status.
* Draft award entries and collect supporting results, visuals, and information from account teams.
* Coordinate reviews and approvals so submissions are accurate and on time.
* Help identify speaking opportunities, agency profiles, and other ways to showcase Konnect's expertise.

**General agency needs**

* Proactively gather campaign wins, coverage, photos, videos, and results from teams.
* Maintain an organized collection of approved marketing assets.
* Set clear internal deadlines, follow up on missing information, and flag obstacles early.
* Support updates to agency credentials, capabilities materials, and case study libraries.
* Track content performance, newsletter engagement, website traffic, and relevant inquiries; recommend practical improvements.

**What you'll bring**

* Approximately 3 years of relevant experience in marketing, communications, PR, journalism, or content.
* Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with samples that demonstrate your ability to tell a clear story.
* Strong organization and the ability to manage several deadlines at once.
* Confidence following up with colleagues at every level and moving work through approvals.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn, Instagram, email marketing platforms, and content scheduling tools.
* Comfort using Canva and collaborating with designers on graphics and simple video content.
* Initiative, curiosity, and sound judgment about what makes a story interesting.
* Comfort using AI tools to support your work, paired with strong editorial judgment and careful fact-checking.

This is a hybrid in-office role with 3 days/week in one of Konnect's hubs (Los Angeles, Chicago). Previous Agency experience in a commensurate role and award submission experience is preferred. As part of the consideration process, applicants will be asked to submit 2-3 writing samples; ideally including social copy, a newsletter, case study, article, or award entry.

Konnect Agency is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

**ACCOUNT COORDINATOR (PART-TIME, DAYTIME)**

**We Realize Potential in** ***Your*** **Story**  
  
We are a multi-platform production company, social media agency, and digital media network who are currently on a quest to find a part-time **Account Coordinator** to join our Social Video Services team - Is this your next opportunity?

The Account Coordinator will be responsible for optimizing video content for YouTube and social platforms across a range of verticals, specifically for daytime shifts.

* **Schedule:** Two days per week, with opportunities to pick up additional shifts as needed. Shifts may include weekends, weekdays, or holidays.
* **Shift Hours:** 9am–6pm.

The day-to-day role will include video optimization, simple analytical report generation, graphic design, copywriting, YouTube channel maintenance, content logging, channel uploads and other general support to the Social Video Services team.

**HOW YOU WILL SPEND YOUR TIME**

* Helping to build and maintain YouTube channels: Optimizing video assets by creating elevated thumbnails using Photoshop or Affinity (depending on the account), well-written titles/descriptions, utilizing all YouTube products, contributing with creative ideation and uploading to a schedule agreed upon with the social video services team
* Growing a YouTube and/or social video audience, and understanding the types of content that keeps them engaged
* Managing community features on YouTube, including creation of images, GIFs and social posts
* Writing copy for posts on YouTube, understanding the importance of editorial voice and tone
* Using YouTube analytics to help inform strategic channel decisions
* Managing a materials library, following existing edit processes and naming conventions
* Emailing with clients, showing prompt communication and professionalism

Skills matter, experience is useful, attitude is everything.

* Good working knowledge of Photoshop to create YouTube thumbnails
* Excellent knowledge of different videos formats, video compression, sound/video synchronisation

* Excellent attention to detail and ability to proof-check your own work

Candidates must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.

jobs.title: Office Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Forte Tools is a Southern California-based manufacturer and wholesaler of tools and equipment, serving retailers, dealers, and distributors across the United States. Our team brings decades of experience in the concrete industry, with a focus on product quality and reliability.

We are seeking an organized and detail-oriented Office Operations Coordinator to support customer order processing, QuickBooks invoicing, shipping coordination, and general office administration. This role works closely with customers, vendors, warehouse staff, and freight providers to ensure accurate orders, timely deliveries, and well-maintained records.

**Responsibilities**

* Process customer orders accurately and efficiently.
* Prepare and issue customer invoices using QuickBooks.
* Coordinate with warehouse staff on inventory availability, order preparation, and shipments.
* Arrange freight shipments, track deliveries, and follow up on shipping updates.
* Communicate with customers, vendors, freight providers, and internal team members regarding orders and operational matters.
* Maintain accurate and organized records of orders, invoices, shipping documents, and customer information.
* Follow up on pending orders, shipments, and customer requests.
* Assist with purchasing, scheduling, and general administrative tasks.
* Support daily office workflows and operational coordination.

**Requirements**

* At least 2 years of relevant work experience, preferably in office administration, order processing, logistics, customer service, or warehouse coordination.
* Fluency in spoken and written English is required. Bilingual English/Chinese skills are strongly preferred; Cantonese proficiency is a plus.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize responsibilities, and follow through on pending orders and requests.
* Effective communication and coordination skills when working with customers, vendors, warehouse staff, and internal teams.

Pay: $24.00 - $35.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Event Coordinator (Temporary)
jobs.description:
### **About Seen Health**

At Seen Health, we are revolutionizing the way senior care is delivered through the PACE (Programs of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly) model. Backed by top VCs, Seen Health is a culturally-focused, technology-enabled healthcare organization that integrates comprehensive medical care and social support with a high-touch, interdisciplinary approach.

Our mission is to empower seniors to age-in-place with dignity and provide their families peace of mind. We are building upon a proven Home and community based services model to create a culturally-competent and scalable PACE program. We are also building a comprehensive operating system focused on data and workflows that span across systems, processes, people, and care contexts. We want to empower our clinicians and staff with tools that deliver relevant data at the time and site of care and enable them to deliver exceptional care to our participants, which improve clinical outcomes, participant & provider satisfaction, and ultimately our strength as an organization.

We are a mission-driven, multidisciplinary team with deep healthcare, technology, and operations expertise, each inspired by our own personal stories of caring for seniors in our lives. Our name, Seen Health, was chosen to reflect our commitment to provide the highest standard of care to underserved older adults while respecting and incorporating their individual beliefs, heritage, and values, so that they can truly be *seen*.

### **\*\*This is a temporary contract position!\*\***

### **About the Role**

The Event Coordinator plays a vital role in Seen Health's community presence and outreach efforts. As the on-the-ground support for the Outreach team, this individual helps plan, prepare, and execute community events that introduce the Seen Health PACE program to seniors, caregivers, and referral partners across the San Gabriel Valley. This role is focused entirely on outreach and event execution — representing the Seen Health brand in the community and ensuring every event runs smoothly, professionally, and on-brand.

The Event Coordinator is a member of the MOE (Marketing, Outreach & Enrollment) Team and works closely with Outreach Specialists to maximize community engagement and lead generation through events.

### **Responsibilities**

**Outreach & Event Responsibilities**

* Represent Seen Health at community events coordinated by Outreach Specialists, including health fairs, mixers, and provider meetings.
* Support the setup, organization, and staffing of events to ensure a positive and engaging experience for all attendees.
* Collect prospective participant information during events and enter accurate data into the Orbit system, assigning leads to the appropriate Outreach Specialists in a timely manner.
* Educate seniors and referral partners about the PACE program and its benefits during community outreach efforts.
* Monitor inventory and prepare marketing materials and giveaways for events, ordering new supplies as necessary to ensure the team is always event-ready.
* Maintain a professional, warm, and approachable demeanor when interacting with the public, seniors, caregivers, and community partners at all outreach events.
* Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of the MOE Playbook and apply its principles to all outreach and event activities.

**General Responsibilities**

* Ensure timely and accurate completion of all required documentation.
* Maintain confidentiality of participant and company information in accordance with HIPAA and company policies.
* Actively participate in team meetings, quality improvement activities, and staff training.
* Keep supervisors informed of workload, priorities, and any issues arising from events or outreach activities.
* Adapt to changing business needs and take on additional responsibilities as assigned.

**Regulatory Requirements**:

Must not be on any exclusion or debarment from participation in Federal Health Care Programs at any time and must remain in good standing with government regulators such as the OIG, (Office of the Inspector General), SAM, (System for Award Management), CMS (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services), etc.

### **Location**

* Regular travel to different settings in the San Gabriel Valley community.
* In center at Seen Health in Alhambra, CA.

### **Salary & Benefits**

* Salary: **$22-$25/hr**

* Benefits: Seen Health is proud to offer a robust benefits offering for our employees. In addition to traditional healthcare coverage, we also offer additional benefits to help further your wellness and feeling of being part of the team.
  + Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family
  + Life Insurance and Disability Benefits
  + Parental and Caregiver Leave
  + Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized
  + Paid Time Off across holidays, vacation time, personal days, and sick days
  + 401k Plan
  + Personal and professional development, including CME support and career growth opportunities
  + Subscriptions and training on using AI tools

jobs.title: Purchasing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Purchasing Coordinator**

**Join Our Team:**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive **Purchasing Coordinator** to join our growing team. This role is responsible for managing the purchasing process from order placement through fulfillment, building strong vendor relationships, negotiating competitive pricing, and ensuring timely delivery of products. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys problem-solving, and excels at coordinating with suppliers, customers, and internal teams.

If you are highly organized, customer-focused, and enjoy working with vendors and sales teams to keep operations running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Create, process, and manage purchase orders with suppliers, vendors, and manufacturers.
* Coordinate product procurement and fulfillment to ensure accurate and timely delivery.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and delivery schedules with suppliers to maximize value and cost savings.
* Maintain strong relationships with vendors and manufacturers while monitoring supplier performance.
* Track and follow up on order status, shipments, backorders, and delivery schedules.
* Process and distribute purchase orders, invoices, and related purchasing documentation.
* Review and analyze purchasing reports and ad hoc data to support business decisions.
* Ensure customer requirements are accurately communicated and executed, including:
  + Product specifications and configurations
  + Quantity increases or decreases
  + Split shipments and multiple orders
  + Special customer requirements
  + Multiple shipping locations
* Serve as a liaison between suppliers, customers, sales teams, and internal departments regarding order status, updates, delays, and fulfillment issues.
* Resolve purchasing and fulfillment discrepancies while maintaining a high level of customer service.
* Maintain accurate records and data within company systems and purchasing platforms.

**Qualifications Required:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel and Word.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer service and relationship-building abilities.
* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Preferred/Not Required:**

* Experience in purchasing, procurement, order management, supply chain, inside sales support, or related roles.
* Knowledge of IT, technology, or Audio Visual (AV) products and solutions.
* Experience working with ERP systems such as NetSuite, Quosal, or similar platforms.
* Experience negotiating pricing and managing vendor relationships.

**What You'll Bring:**

* A sense of urgency and ownership.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
* A customer-first mindset.
* The ability to build productive relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* A commitment to accuracy, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Paid vacation
* Additional company perks

**About GST**

About Golden Star Technology (GST)

Hollywood Park is a premier, nearly 300-acre global sports and entertainment destination in Inglewood, California. Owned, operated, and being developed by Los Angeles Rams Owner/Chairman E. Stanley Kroenke, it stands as the largest urban mixed-use development currently under construction in the Western United States. The vibrant "city within a city" features sophisticated residences, a dynamic outdoor retail and lifestyle district, creative office spaces, public parks, and a scenic lake. Anchored by the world-class SoFi Stadium and YouTube Theater, with Hollywood Park Studios and a luxury boutique hotel forthcoming, the district creates the ultimate Live, Work, Play environment.  
  
Home to the Los Angeles Chargers and Super Bowl LVI Champion Los Angeles Rams, the 3.1 million-square-foot SoFi Stadium is the NFL’s largest venue, and the first indoor-outdoor stadium. It seats approximately 70,000, expandable to 100,000, with more than 260 luxury suites and over 13,000 premium seats. A proven global leader that consistently ranks among the world’s top venues in ticket sales, the stadium has already hosted iconic events like eight FIFA World Cup 2026 matches, Super Bowl LVI, the 2023 College Football National Championship, WrestleMania 39, the CONCACAF Gold Cup Final, and numerous record-breaking concerts. Adjacent to the stadium and under the same sweeping translucent roof canopy sits the 2.5-acre open-air American Airlines Plaza and the 6,000-seat YouTube Theater. jobs.description:
**About:**

**At Project Youth OC (PYOC), our mission is to meet young people at a turning point and, through guidance, education, and family-centered support, empower them to build a path toward success.** As one of Orange County’s longest-standing and most effective youth-serving organizations, PYOC provides prevention, intervention, mentorship, and parent enrichment programs that strengthen families, expand access to resources, and keep at-promise youth in school, healthy, and connected to opportunity. Every day, and in every role, our staff contribute to this mission by delivering individualized, culturally responsive services that uplift youth and caregivers, serving more than 1,500 young people and families each year through our commitment to empowerment, collaboration, accountability, and community connection.

**Role:** Program Specialist

**Program:** Shortstop

**Department:** Youth Development Programs

**Classification:** Non-exempt Full Time

**Summary**:

The **Program Specialist** is an entry-level position that plays an essential frontline role within the **Shortstop Diversion and Behavioral Support Program**, supporting youth and their caregivers as they navigate a structured intervention designed to reduce recidivism and strengthen family communication. * Demonstrated passion for empowering youth and supporting families through restorative, strengths-based approaches.

* Coursework or a degree in **Education, Human Services, Sociology, Criminology, Counseling, Social Work**, or a related field.

jobs.title: AI-First Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Elite Open School**

Since 1987, Elite Education Group has trained generations of students and families worldwide to achieve their American education dreams. Elite Open School, founded in Southern California in 2015, provides accredited blended education for middle and high school students in the U.S. and abroad. EOS is accredited by both WASC and Cognia, offering UC-approved courses and College Board-approved APs.

**The Role: Why AI-First?**

This is not a traditional administrative role. We are looking for someone who sees every repetitive task as a problem to solve with AI. Your primary mission is to **reduce complexity, time, cost, and burden** across school operations by identifying, building, and maintaining AI-powered workflows and automations. You will be a part of the administrative foundation of our school and you will help us do it smarter, faster, and more efficiently than before.

We want you to figure out how to leverage the latest AI tools, integrations, and automations so that manual processes become automated pipelines, communication becomes streamlined, and our team can focus on what matters most: our students and their families.

**Core ResponsibilitiesAI Workflow Design & Automation**

* Audit existing administrative processes and identify opportunities for AI automation and augmentation
* Research, evaluate, and implement AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Zapier, Make, Notion AI, Google AI features) to streamline school operations
* Build and maintain automated workflows for enrollment processing, student registration, data entry, withdrawals, and records management
* Design integrations between school systems (SIS, LMS, email, Slack, Google Workspace) to eliminate manual data transfer and reduce errors
* Create AI-assisted templates, auto-responses, and smart routing for common inquiries across email, Slack, and phone
* Document all automations and workflows so they are reproducible, trainable, and scalable

**School Administration (AI-Augmented)**

* Manage student information and data across school systems—using AI to flag inconsistencies, automate updates, and generate reports
* Handle Elite Open School communications—leveraging AI drafting, summarization, and prioritization tools
* Maintain thorough knowledge of EOS services and proactively surface relevant information to team members using AI-powered knowledge bases or internal chatbots
* Support team projects by responding to requests for assistance, using AI to accelerate research, document creation, and task coordination
* Oversee onboarding documentation and internal training materials—keeping them current and accessible, ideally through AI-generated or AI-updated resources
* Provide general administrative and clerical support, continuously seeking ways to automate or semi-automate recurring tasks

**Continuous Improvement & Reporting**

* Track time and cost savings generated by AI implementations and report on ROI to leadership
* Stay current on emerging AI tools, trends, and best practices relevant to education administration and edtech
* Proactively propose new automations and process improvements on a monthly basis
* Train team members on new AI tools and workflows as they are deployed

**Ideal Candidate ProfileMindset & Disposition**

* AI-curious and proactive—you experiment with new tools before being asked to
* Growth mindset with a bias toward action and iteration
* Comfort with ambiguity; you can figure things out without a playbook
* Patience, sincerity, and compassion in student- and family-facing interactions
* Genuine interest in growing within education and/or the edtech industry

**Skills & Capabilities**

* Demonstrated ability to use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar) for real work tasks—not just casual use
* Experience with or willingness to quickly learn workflow automation platforms (Zapier, Make/Integromat, Power Automate, or similar)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong self-organization and attention to detail
* Ability to present oneself professionally and thrive in a fast-paced environment
* Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, and common SaaS tools
* Strong familiarity with administrative functions and server management in Discord

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher
* US work authorization required
* Portfolio, write-up, or demo of a workflow or process you’ve automated or improved using AI

**Career Foundations & Growth Tracks**

While this is an entry-level role, we place a strong emphasis on internal promotion and long-term growth. The ideal career progression moves from this role into supervising future AI-First Admin Coordinators, with potential advancement toward school leadership and school board governance positions. Elite works with each employee to ensure personal development, diverse experiences, and notable growth in the following areas:

* AI Operations & Process Engineering
* Management – Hiring, Training, Team Development
* Local or Regional Marketing
* Business or Brand Development – New Campus Startup or Established Campus Development
* Seminars and Public Speaking
* Public or International School Relations
* International Project Coordination
* Technology – AI Implementation, EdTech Development, Google Services, Systems Integration

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Full-Time: $35,000 – $45,000 annually
* Monthly Salary with Structured Bonuses
* Health Care
* Career Building Foundation
* Best Company Culture and Teamwork

**More About Elite Open School**

We aim to prepare students for the 4th Industrial Revolution. The acceleration in AI, robotics, biotech, and automation demands that we equip students with creativity, advanced communication, critical thinking, and cognitive flexibility. Elite Open School is uniquely “Open” to creativity-based education through multilingual campuses, digital and adaptive curriculum, individualized pacing, and unlimited experiential learning opportunities.

jobs.description:
**Social Media Manager**

Location: Orange County, California (onsite)  
Employment type: Full time

**About Black Stag**

Black Stag is a digital marketing agency in Orange County. We run social media, email, paid ads, design and web for a portfolio of brands.

**About the role**

We are hiring a Social Media Manager to own organic social for several brands. You set the strategy, run the content calendar and direct short-form video. You also manage the community and report results tied to business goals. You work closely with our designers, video editors, email team and paid ads team.

**What you will do**

* Build a social strategy and a monthly content calendar for each brand, tied to clear goals.
* Plan, script and direct short-form video for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Facebook.
* Brief designers, video editors and creators, and review their work before it goes live.
* Write captions and on-screen text with search in mind, since people now search inside social apps.
* Publish and schedule posts on time, every day, across every brand.
* Answer comments and messages, and pass customer issues to the right team.
* Follow each brand's content rules and each platform's policies, and check every post before it goes out.
* Find, brief and manage creators and influencers, and track whether their work drives traffic and sales.
* Work with the paid ads team to boost top organic posts and test new angles.
* Report weekly on reach, engagement, follower growth, link clicks and sales, with what you will change next.
* Keep up with platform changes, trends and AI tools, and bring new ideas to the team.

**What you bring**

* 4 or more years in social media management, with at least 2 at an agency or running several brands at once.
* A portfolio of short-form video and campaigns you led, with results.
* Strong writing in English and a sharp eye for design and video.
* Hands-on experience with Meta Business Suite, TikTok, YouTube Studio and Google Analytics.
* Experience with a scheduling tool such as Sprout Social, Later, Metricool or Buffer.
* Comfort with Canva, CapCut and Adobe Creative Cloud.
* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude for ideas, scripts and captions, with your own judgment on top.
* Strong organization under deadlines, using ClickUp or a similar tool.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with brands in regulated categories, where platform rules are strict.
* Experience running Meta or TikTok ads.
* Basic SEO knowledge.

**How we measure success**

* Every brand posts on schedule, with no missed days.

Covenant House California (CHC) is a nonprofit organization that provides sanctuary and support for youth overcoming homelessness, ages 18-24. CHC believes that no young person deserves to be homeless; that every young person in California deserves housing, food, clothing, education, and most importantly, to be loved. CHC provides a full continuum of services to meet the physical, emotional, educational, vocational, and spiritual well-being of young people.

CHC’s doors are open to youth and staff regardless of their race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We believe that youth and team members deserve to be in an environment that is inclusive and affirming; where everyone is treated with dignity and respect and valued and appreciated for who they are. Maintaining a diverse community of youth and staff is key to our ability to achieve our mission most effectively. We are also committed to being a leader in advancing anti-racism, and to promoting opportunities for the free expression of the lived experiences of our youth and staff.

We are looking for people who, like us, believe that every young person deserves a place to belong. We think it takes all kinds of people to create diverse solutions to end youth homelessness and we are on a committed journey to build an inclusive and equitable work culture that brings out the best in everyone.

jobs.description:
**Femmes Against Violence Program**  
**Program Coordinator**

***Full-time, Union Position***

Horizons Unlimited of San Francisco, Inc. (Horizons), established in 1965, is a community-based organization located in the Mission District and offers substance use prevention and early intervention, employment/workforce development, mental health and wellness, multimedia arts, and gender-affirming services, to Latine and all youth of color, up to age 24, and their families residing in the Mission District and throughout San Francisco.

Our programs help young people understand the systems that create inequality and how those systems affect their lives. We create safe spaces where they can make sense of their experiences, build healthy coping skills, and find their own power within these systems. Young people leave with the tools to take care of themselves and their communities and to create real change on their own terms.

**Program Description:** Femmes Against Violence (FAV) is an 18-week, cohort-based program that promotes healing, agency, leadership, and self-determination among youth ages 14–21, including femme-identified and gender-expansive youth of color. Offered twice annually, FAV engages youth three days per week through culturally affirming, gender-responsive, youth-centered programming.

The program integrates intersectional, liberatory frameworks grounded in Black feminist theory, Indigenous teachings, ancestral knowledge, collective care, and community accountability through interactive workshops, experiential activities, community outings, guest speakers, and youth-led action projects. Programming explores identity, culture, relationships, gender-based violence prevention, systems of power and oppression, and pathways toward personal and collective well-being. Youth develop critical consciousness, leadership, advocacy, communication, and self-determination skills while engaging in opportunities to apply their learning through creative and experiential activities.

FAV also provides a wraparound support model that connects youth to mental health and wellness, case management, educational, housing, and other community resources. FAV creates a supportive space where youth can build belonging, strengthen their voices and leadership capacity, develop healthy coping and relationship skills, and envision and pursue futures grounded in care, justice, and self-determination.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate and oversee delivery of the FAV program in accordance with the approved work plan and scope of services, including outreach and recruitment, orientation and enrollment, life skills, peer education, leadership development, culturally and gender-affirming activities and events, youth-led projects, and related services.
* Develop, implement, and adapt program curriculum, workshops, training materials, and experiential activities that support FAV program goals and youth outcomes.
* Facilitate culturally and gender-affirming trainings, workshops, group activities, presentations, and community outings for FAV participants.
* Support youth in developing and implementing creative projects, presentations, educational materials, and other activities that promote awareness, leadership, advocacy, and positive community engagement.

jobs.title: Producer / Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Great stories start with extraordinary people.**
==================================================

We’re bringing together exceptional creative talent to tell the stories of people shaping the future. Work alongside people who raise your standards, champion your ideas, and give you room to do the best work of your career.

*Story inspires science. Science makes story real.*

**Your Story**
--------------

We're looking for a Junior Producer / Production Coordinator who's organized, resourceful, and hungry to make great films.

Story produces high-end commercial and branded content for some of the world's most ambitious companies, alongside a growing slate of original scripted fiction and nonfiction projects.

You'll work directly with our producers and creative team to bring these productions to life. One day, you might be coordinating crew and logistics for a commercial shoot. The next, you're scouting locations, organizing equipment, or helping pull together a documentary production on a tight deadline.

We're looking for someone who takes initiative, figures things out, and doesn't wait to be told what to do. You're comfortable juggling a dozen moving pieces, solving problems on the fly, and doing whatever it takes to help a production succeed.

This is an opportunity to get hands-on experience across every stage of filmmaking, take on real responsibility, and grow into a producer capable of leading your own projects.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* **Keep productions moving.** Support multiple projects simultaneously, coordinating schedules, logistics, crew, equipment, locations, and travel.
* **Make things happen.** Research locations, source equipment, track down vendors, and find creative solutions to production challenges.
* **Coordinate crews and vendors.** Help book crew, manage communications, coordinate availability, and ensure everyone has the information they need.
* **Stay on top of the details.** Maintain production calendars, call sheets, contact lists, schedules, budgets, and other essential production documents.
* **Support shoots on set.** Help manage day-of logistics, coordinate with crew, and handle unexpected problems to keep productions running smoothly.
* **Track budgets and expenses.** Help prepare estimates, collect invoices, track spending, and keep production finances organized.
* **Support projects from start to finish.** Work with producers and the creative team throughout pre-production, filming, and post-production.
* **Take ownership.** Anticipate what needs to happen next, identify problems early, and take initiative to solve them without waiting for instructions.

**You're the Right Person If**
------------------------------

* You have some experience working in film, commercial production, documentaries, or a related creative production environment.
* You're extremely organized and can keep track of multiple projects, deadlines, and details at once.
* You're resourceful and persistent. When you hit a roadblock, you look for another way forward.
* You're proactive and take ownership of your work. You don't need constant direction to get things done.
* You're a clear communicator who can work confidently with crew, vendors, clients, and creative teams.
* You're comfortable with production tools, spreadsheets, budgets, calendars, and scheduling.
* You're adaptable and happy to jump between planning at a desk and solving problems on set.
* You have a genuine interest in filmmaking and want to understand every part of the production process.
* You're based in the SF Bay Area or willing to relocate.

**What Sets You Apart**
-----------------------

**You're relentlessly resourceful.** You don't give up when something gets difficult. You'll make the extra call, find another option, and keep pushing until you've figured it out.

**You're one step ahead.** You anticipate what needs to happen next and take care of details before anyone has to ask. You make the people around you more effective.

**You're organized under pressure.** You can juggle several projects, respond to last-minute changes, and keep everything moving without losing track of the details.

**You have a get-it-done attitude.** No task is beneath you. Whether it's building a production schedule, tracking down a location contact, or making a last-minute equipment run, you take pride in getting things done right.

**You want to become a great producer.** You're curious, ambitious, and excited to learn from experienced filmmakers. You don't just want to coordinate productions. You want to understand how they're built and lead them yourself.

We do this by automating document intake, prior authorizations, and appeals at scale to streamline operations and accelerate care. We classify medical referrals, understand chart notes, and automate contract and reimbursement search to provide patients with accurate coverage determinations and cost responsibility. Your job is to find the right people, start great conversations, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives. You'll work closely with our GTM Engineer and AEs, and report to Mike Barbour (VP of Sales).

This role is built for early-career people with a steep learning curve. You'll learn how specialty pharmacies, infusion centers, provider groups, and health systems get patients on therapy, and you'll have a clear path to grow into a closing role.

In order to be considered for this position candidate must be serving permanently in the title, or reachable on the civil service list.
  
  
The Transportation Planning and Management Division (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility and markings, and ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  
  
Research, Implementation, and Safety unit (RIS) is a multi-disciplinary team dedicated to making the streets of New York City safer for all users as part of Vision Zero, a citywide policy striving to eliminate serious injuries and fatalities from traffic crashes. School Safety, a unit within RIS, is responsible for improving safety near K-12 schools throughout New York City. The group redesigns streets next to schools with a goal of reducing child injuries, improving safety and accessibility, and encouraging non-motorized transportation in all five boroughs. School Safety advises NYC agencies and private parties on school siting and various policy and street design issues related to youth safety and school operations. The unit manages all curb regulations and signage next to NYC K-12 schools, including the School Slow Zone program.
  
  
Under the direction of senior staff and with wide latitude for independent judgment, the candidate will be responsible for planning, developing, designing, and implementing Street Improvement Projects (SIPs) to improve safety for all roadway users with a particular emphasis on child safety, in order to advance the goals of the NYC Streets Plan and the Vision Zero Action Plan. This role will involve project management, extensive community outreach, research, data analysis, implementation coordination, and field work.
  
  
The selected candidate will analyze crash and traffic data; create street designs using AutoCAD; coordinate with staff throughout DOT and partner city agencies; perform extensive community outreach to schools, elected officials, Community Boards, inter-and intra-agency members, and other stakeholders; develop and deliver public presentations; and manage implementation of new roadway designs. Outreach work with students in NYC schools may be required on some of the projects. Additionally, the candidate will have the opportunity to investigate new design treatments and policy initiatives, to develop and pilot innovative safety treatments, and to develop new capital projects for implementation by the Department of Design and Construction on behalf of NYC DOT School Safety. The candidate will also coordinate research efforts; participate in technical and advisory committee meetings; and work with DOT staff and external agency representatives on studies and projects.
  
  
Additional tasks may include reviewing community requests as related to school safety and operations in NYC. Furthermore, the candidate will help the team deliver on the ambitious goal of Mayor Mamdani’s administration to install a 15-mile-per-hour school slow zone next to every K-12 school in NYC by the end of 2029 and assist with planning and coordination tasks associated with the School Slow Zone program.
  
  
The Department of Transportation's (DOT) mission is to provide for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods in the City of New York and to maintain and enhance the transportation infrastructure crucial to the economic vitality and quality of life of our primary customers, City residents.
  
  
CITY PLANNER - 22122

  
  

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

  
  

1. A master’s degree from an accredited college or university in city planning, urban planning, urban design, architecture, landscape architecture, transportation engineering, public administration, economic development or a related field; or
  
  
2. A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university and one year of satisfactory full-time experience in city planning such as in the review and
  
development of housing, transportation, environmental, and city-owned land planning projects; or
  
  
3. A satisfactory combination of education and/or experience that is equivalent to "1" above. Graduate education in city planning, urban planning, urban design, architecture, landscape architecture, transportation engineering, public administration, economic development or related fields may be substituted for experience on the basis of 30 graduate semester credits from an accredited college or university for one year of experience. However, all candidates must have a baccalaureate degree.
  
  
4. To be eligible for placement in Assignment Level III, individuals must have, after meeting the minimum requirements, two additional years of professional experience as described in "2" above.

  
  

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

  
Proficient in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, AutoCAD, and Adobe Creative Suite. Knowledge of traffic calming, urban design, pedestrian-oriented design, and complete streets is required. Excellent writing, editing, oral presentation, and community outreach skills are a must. Knowledge of traffic engineering and data analysis, including Synchro and ArcGIS, is preferred. Preference will be given to candidate who possess a driver's license valid in the state of New York with no restrictions. This license must be maintain

At Henderson, We're About More Than Just Buildings
  
We're about the people, experiences, and longevity of a building. We’re a company of problem-solvers and innovators known for our technical excellence and ability to provide come up with out-of-the-box solutions when it comes to design and construction. We love the process of bringing buildings to life – and keeping them in shape long after the doors open.
  
  
As an ESOP, each of our employee-owners are an essential part of our mission to lead the industry in innovation, sustainability, and client experience. With a vision to build a better world, Team Henderson has a people-first culture and diverse portfolio of world-class facilities.
  
  
It's What We Do
  
We provide total building system design and construction services across multiple high-growth markets throughout the country for industry leaders. You'll get to use your talent to work on projects for some of the biggest names in mission-critical, higher education, sports, healthcare, grocery, restaurant, and retail within the sectors we serve in business, community, grocery, health, retail, and venue.
  
  
It's How We're Different
  
We're about more than just buildings. We're about you. You, and the hundreds of passionate employee-owners who make us who we are. We’ve always been committed to providing an inclusive workplace where people can bring their full self to work and helps people reach their full potential – both as professionals and individuals. Together, we provide dream-up innovative solutions for our clients industry-wide problems, design and construct spaces that become landmarks, and toast the good life at our happy hours. Take a peek into what makes us different here: https://youtu.be/AIt17t\_uJ-A?si=oSMy5zQeUcb\_faE3
  
  
Position Summary
  
Project Coordinators support Project Managers in organizing and executing projects by managing schedules, deliverables, documentation, and communication. While not responsible for leading projects, they are expected to develop a project management mindset—actively learning how projects are structured, tracked, and delivered. This role serves as an entry point into project management while building foundational knowledge of engineering design, construction practices, and project delivery processes.
  
.
  
  
Essential Job Functions & Accountabilities
  
Project Management
  

* Supports project execution and coordination with increasing independence under the direction of the Project Manager.
* Assists in the development of project proposals and contract coordination to build foundational knowledge of scope, fee, and delivery planning.
* Coordinates the development and tracking of project deliverables.
* Assists in the scheduling and assignment of tasks to internal team members.
* Organizes, attends, and documents project meetings with attention to follow-through and accountability.
* Supports internal and external project communication to ensure consistent information sharing across stakeholders.
* Maintains and monitors project plans, schedules, work hours, budgets, and expenditures.
* Actively shadows Project Managers to build skills in communication, coordination, influence, and professional judgment.

Program Management (where applicable)
  

* Supports fee development, project setup and scoping practices for program projects.
* Assists in coordinating client service and communication across designated program efforts.

Quality
  

* Assists with communicating and coordinating project quality expectations.
* Helps maintain project quality documentation and supports the quality review process.
* Identifies project-related issues and proactively works with the Project Manager to support resolution.

Client Experience
  

* Serves as a secondary point of contact on select project tasks.
* Partners with the Project Manager to ensure client needs and perspectives are considered in project execution.
* Supports resolution of project-related issues and coordinates responses to client inquiries.
* Assists Project Managers with client relationship maintenance and business development efforts as requested.

Core Competencies
  
  
Communication
  

* Keeps others informed conveying information clearly and with an appropriate level of detail
* Listens attentively to others and takes an interest in what they have to say
* Responds openly to others encouraging honest, productive communication

Integrity
  

* Demonstrates consideration for the opinions, perspectives, and experiences others
* Takes responsibility for personal actions and delivers on commitments
* Aims to understand how actions impact others

Quality Orientation
  

* Takes steps to ensure work is done correctly
* Delivers on client expectations
* Strives to follow policies and procedures

Teamwork/Inclusion
  

* Shares time and effort with others
* Takes interest and learns from the diversity of others
* Shows enthusiasm for team goals

Continuous Learning
  

* Views mistakes as a growth opportunity
* Recognizes gaps in personal knowledge and pursues opportunities to learn
* Engages others when tackling an unfamiliar task or responsibility

Functional/Technical Expertise
  

* Recognizes routine problems and identify solutions
* Keeps up with industry and/or discipline standards
* Maintains best practice throughout all job functions

Required Education, Experience, Licenses & Technical Competencies
  

* Associate or bachelor’s degree preferred
* 4 years of relevant experience required, with 2 years cumulative of project support experience
* Basic understanding of project execution required
* Basic understanding of building design and construction principles required
* Self-starter with the ability to influence and motivate others to achieve goals
* Successful track record of effective collaboration, communication and organization skills.
* Must demonstrate proficiency in all core competencies as described in this job description.

The Workplace Experience Program Specialist owns employee events, programs, and experience initiatives end-to-end, from initial brief and stakeholder alignment through planning, production, and post-initiative review, and serves as the primary workplace experience partner to our senior leaders. This role is New York, USA-based.

The Specialist operates independently across a varied portfolio of concurrent work, managing vendors, cross-functional partners, and budgets. Success requires the ability to move fluidly between strategic advisory and hands-on delivery shaping the brief with a department head one day, managing a venue walkthrough the next.

**Key Responsibilities**

Event Planning & Delivery

Own assigned events from end-to-end, from brief through delivery and post-event wrap. The scope, scale, and complexity of what is owned increases with seniority, as does the degree of independent judgement expected at each stage.

* Own end-to-end delivery of employee events, programs, and experience initiatives across the US
* Build project plans, run-of-show documents, and risk plans for complex or large-scale events
* Manage vendor sourcing, negotiations, contracts, and on-site relationships
* Oversee full budget management: forecasting, reconciliation, and reporting
* Coordinate cross-functional support (facilities, IT, People team, etc.) to ensure seamless execution
* Ensure legal and compliance requirements are met across all event-related procurement

Stakeholder Partnership

* Serve as the primary workplace experience partner to department heads and People leadership in the US
* Lead stakeholder briefings and alignment sessions; translate business intent into experience design
* Advise on event strategy: help leadership determine the right format, investment level, and experience goals
* Manage expectations proactively; navigate competing priorities and tight timelines with clarity

Standards & Process

* Apply and uphold our event and experience execution standards; adapt frameworks for the US market context
* Contribute to the development and refinement of global event standards, playbooks, and the service catalog
* Introduce new event formats and experience approaches that raise the bar for employee programming
* Maintain accurate records: post-event documentation, budget actuals, attendance data, and learnings

Data & Continuous Improvement

* Own the US events measurement approach: collect, analyze, and report on experience quality and employee sentiment
* Produce post-event reports and strategic write-ups; link outcomes to broader employee experience goals
* Analyze trends across the US event portfolio to inform future program investment and priorities

Collaboration & Teamwork

* Work closely with the global Workplace Experience team to align the US event portfolio with broader workplace experience strategy
* Partner with the Experience Design team on integrated experiences where events connect to broader business outcomes
* Represent the Workplace Experience function in US-based cross-functional planning forums

**What We're Looking For**

Genuine passion for employee experience, the ability to operate independently across a varied and concurrent portfolio, and the credibility to partner with senior leaders on experience strategy.

* At least 4-6 years of experience, including ownership of large-scale events or employee experience programs
* Proven track record delivering events and programs from concept through completion- on time, on brand, and on budget
* Strategic thinker who can move between vision and execution without losing either
* Strong stakeholder manager: shapes briefs, manages expectations at leadership level, and advocates for the employee experience
* Comfortable developing playbooks, processes, and standards- both for their own work and as contributions to the broader global team
* Deep knowledge of event production: vendor markets, technical production, and logistics
* Self-directed and adaptable; comfortable owning the full delivery chain independently

*There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. jobs.description:
Want to make cancer suck less and actually enjoy doing it? Stupid Cancer is looking to fill the open role of Programs and Community Coordinator with someone who is organized, outgoing, and wildly efficient to join our small but mighty team.

Reporting to the Program Manager, you will tackle a dynamic mix of programmatic, administrative, and community-facing initiatives. If you are a collaborative problem-solver with stellar communication skills and a passion for making programs run like clockwork, we want you on our team.

Stupid Cancer is the leader in adolescent and young adult (AYA ages 15 - 39) cancer support, education, and advocacy. Since 2007, Stupid Cancer has provided a lifeline of support, community, and resources of the AYA cancer community. Our vision is that everyone affected by AYA cancer can Get Busy Living.

The Stupid Cancer team reports to our New York City headquarters at least 2 days a week. Therefore, only candidates in the NYC area will be considered.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Community Engagement & Support**

* Develop and strengthen strong relationships with community members and nonprofit partners to foster continued growth in program participation.
* Support the planning and implementation of Stupid Cancer's core programs including, but not limited to, Meetups, Stupid Cancer Stories, and CancerCon.
* Recruit, train, and support in the management of program participants and volunteers across various initiatives, including Meetup Hosts, to facilitate impactful community spaces.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for all community member inquiries.
* Represent Stupid Cancer professionally at virtual and in-person programs including CancerCon, industry conferences, and networking events as needed (includes occasional evening and weekend commitments).

**Administrative & Operational Ef**fi**ciencies**

* Provide comprehensive administrative and operational support across all Stupid Cancer programs and events.
* Build, manage, and track all programmatic events within Cvent (the organization’s event management and registration platform) and Neon (the organization’s CRM) to ensure seamless cross-departmental coordination.
* Maintain and systematically update the organizational program calendar, ensuring all events are accurately published on the Stupid Cancer Calendar of Events webpage in a timely manner.

**Communications Support**

* Partner closely with the Communications Manager to support the drafting of programmatic email marketing, social media campaign content, website updates, and overall digital/printed asset creation, with training provided on specific platforms as necessary.
* Monitor the organization's social media channels, engaging authentically with followers to foster a vibrant online community.

**Other Duties**

* Fulfill additional duties and special projects as assigned.
* Actively collaborate across all departments to ensure alignment on projects and initiatives.
* Occasional program implementation on evenings and weekends.

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

* Four-year college degree (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
* Excellent communication and customer service skills (email, phone, and face-to-face).
* Strong organizational skills with a keen eye for detail.
* Ability to juggle multiple priorities simultaneously and take initiative on new tasks.
* Prior experience building relationships with diverse groups of people and managing volunteers.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Suite, and standard social media channels.
* Legally eligible to work in the United States; no sponsorship provided.
* Two years of related professional experience preferred.
* Experience with WordPress and Mail Chimp preferred.
* Experience with Canva Preferred.
* Familiarity with the AYA Cancer community preferred.

The salary range for this full-time, non-exempt position is $45,000 - $50,000. Eligible to participate in Stupid Cancer’s comprehensive benefits program including Medical, Dental, Life and Disability Insurance, a 401K matching Plan, and more.

To apply, submit your cover letter and resume via this application form. \*Applications without a cover letter or resume will not be considered. Applicants will be reviewed on a rolling basis until this position is filled.

**Americans with Disability Speci**fi**cations: Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl; talk or hear; taste or smell.
* The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds.

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

The Belfer Center for Innovation & Social Impact is seeking a highly organized and collaborative Program Coordinator to support the Center’s operations and growing portfolio of programs.

Reporting to the Senior Director and working closely with the Belfer Center team, the Program Coordinator will maintain the systems, logistics, communications, and administrative processes that keep the Center’s work moving forward. The role will also provide programmatic support across initiatives focused on leadership development, community building, civic engagement, and social innovation.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys creating structure, coordinating across teams, and contributing to meaningful programs in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment. The ideal candidate is thoughtful, detail-oriented, and comfortable balancing a range of responsibilities.

We welcome candidates from a variety of professional backgrounds. Previous experience in the nonprofit, arts and culture, or social impact sectors is helpful but not required.

Job Responsibilities Include:

* Support the day-to-day operations of the Belfer Center, including designated email accounts, calendars, files, contact lists, and shared team resources.
* Coordinate internal and external meetings, including scheduling, preparation of materials, agendas, notes, action items, and follow-up.
* Provide administrative and coordination support across the Belfer Center’s programs and initiatives, including research, written materials, presentations, and participant communications.
* Coordinate logistics for meetings, workshops, public programs, cohort gatherings, receptions, and other events, including room reservations, food and beverage, invitations, RSVPs, registration, materials, and on-site needs.
* Work with 92NY departments and external partners to support program and event planning and execution.
* Support communications and relationships with program participants, alumni, partners, speakers, and other members of the Belfer Center community.
* Attend selected programs and events, including occasional evening and weekend events, to provide on-site support.
* Work with the Belfer Center team and 92NY’s Finance Department to process invoices, payments, reimbursements, contracts, and related documentation, and assist with budget tracking and expense reconciliation.
* Maintain and improve internal systems, project-management tools, databases, workflows, templates, and recurring procedures.
* May be assigned other tasks and duties reasonably related to the role.

Experience, Education, & Skills Desired:

* Bachelor’s degree.
* 2-3 years of relevant work experience.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and details simultaneously.
* Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, polished work.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues and partners.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic environment where priorities may evolve.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace, and using project-management, database, email marketing, survey, registration, and customer relationship management platforms. Experience with tools such as Monday.com, HubSpot, Salesforce, Typeform, Mailchimp, or similar platforms is helpful.
* Previous experience supporting nonprofit programs, events, fundraising, operations, or administrative systems is helpful but not required.

Founded in 1971 in Long Island City, Queens **,** LaGuardia Community College is one of seven community colleges of the City University of New York (CUNY). LaGuardia offers more than sixty associate degree programs and more than fifty workforce training, ESOL, GED, and pre-college programs. In 2023, LaGuardia served approximately 24,000 students. More than one-third of LaGuardia’s degree-seeking students are born outside the United States; they come from 136 countries and speak 43 heritage languages. Sixty percent are first-generation college students.

Virtually all LaGuardia students are ethnic minorities (89 percent), 58 percent are women, 27 percent are over the age of 25. Forty-six percent of associate degree students are Hispanic. **Overview**

What began in 2017 as an idea on the back of a napkin has quickly become an award-winning, fastest-growing communications firm working with some big-name consumer and B2B technology brands. At SourceCode, we’re focused on bringing brains and hustle, humanity and technology, creativity and business intelligence back to public relations.

jobs.title: Programmatic Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Wunderkind:**

Wunderkind ads are 'behaviorally triggered', meaning that ads are served on a premium list of publishers only when a user is done consuming content. Our proprietary tag is integrated directly on the publisher page to track on-site user behavior - making '**net new'** ad placements. *How* we serve the ad is why we are different from our competitors in-market.

Rather than placing an ad in front of someone while they're actively trying to read content, our technology patiently waits until a visitor has stopped reading before rendering our ad on the page. And that patience pays off - it turns out that when an ad experience respects the user's reason for visiting a page, the user respects the ad experience in return. This unique, brand safe approach to ad experience gives an advertiser's message more attention and greater engagement.

**About the Role:**

Here at Wunderkind, we have an innovative and truly differentiated enterprise product that fundamentally changes how publishers monetize their websites and you can play a key part in leading that shift.

Wunderkind Ads is looking for a top-performing Account Manager to work with our existing business team to retain and expand agency, trading desk, brand and DSP accounts across the midwest region. A global fintech leader, Acrisure empowers millions of ambitious businesses and individuals with the right solutions to grow boldly forward. Bringing cutting-edge technology and top-tier human support together, we connect clients with customized solutions across a range of insurance, reinsurance, payroll, benefits, cybersecurity, mortgage services – and more.

jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We are Rippling’s sherpas – both for our customers and colleagues. We bring our customers along on the journey as we rapidly enhance and expand the first-of-a-kind employee management platform. We’re looking for a self-driven, growth-minded account manager with a proven track record of success to join our hybrid-remote US-based Account Management team.

You are the primary relationship owner for each of your customers to guide them in optimizing the use of Rippling’s suite of back-office HR products and solutions. You will navigate complex customer issues and priorities and lead initiatives in your book to meet company objectives for customer adoption, retention, and revenue growth. Account managers in our Strategic segment own revenue retention and growth of our largest customers.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Ensure our customers in the HR Services channel are realizing value and expanding across the platform.
* Proactively engage customers in your book via key lifecycle events: “go live”, benefits renewal, executive business reviews, contract renewal, etc.
* You will field customer requests and lead initiatives in your book to meet company objectives for customer adoption, retention, and revenue growth.
* Consult with clients to understand their HR, IT, Finance, and global workforce management needs through a solutions-based selling approach.
* Navigate a sales process by building relationships with multiple stakeholders through remote meetings.
* Negotiate and coordinate customer procurement and contract execution
* Build and manage a pipeline of new subscription cross-sales, product upgrades, and contract renewals to quarterly targets.
* Develop and demonstrate a broad knowledge of current and new Rippling products via executing customer adoption playbooks and prospecting.
* Partner with your Technical Account Manager to devise account plans, long-term goals, and client strategies; and with cross-functional teams to ensure customer success and secure long-term commitments.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 4+ years of SaaS experience in account management, sales, or quota-carrying customer success
* Track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota via new product sales and upgrades (license expansion sales are not likely relevant)
* Competitive and creative drive to win over customers and think outside the box to get a deal done
* Demonstrated ability to run a sales discovery and demo meeting and run a structured sales process
* Proven success building and maintaining long-term commercial relationships (experience managing multi-year renewals)

To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com
