jobs.description:
**About the role and team**  
  
Account Management at Uber means navigating ambiguity, earning trust fast, and solving problems that don’t come with a script. In this role, you will own the growth and success of a portfolio of SMB restaurant partners, acting as their primary advisor to unlock the full potential of the Uber Eats platform. It is a high-stakes environment where your ability to build long-term partnerships directly impacts the livelihood of local businesses and Uber’s mission to move the real world.  
  
The work is fast-paced and requires a grit-based mindset; you will deal with shifting priorities, handle tough negotiations, and build lasting partnerships. We are looking for resourceful owners who are energised by the complex reality of Account Management and can stay resilient through the inevitable "no" to find creative solutions for our partners. If you thrive on autonomy and are motivated by seeing the tangible impact of your work on the community, this is where you will grow.  
  
*This position is based in New York City and follows a hybrid work schedule, with an in-office requirement Tuesday through Thursday.* ***Fluency in Mandarin is also required*** *for this role.*  
  
**What you’ll do**  
  

* Build and grow long-term partnerships by understanding what matters most to your restaurant partners - doing the right thing long term.
* Manage partner portfolios with urgency and discipline, using data-driven insights to track KPIs and identify opportunities for optimization.
* Navigate ambiguity and complexity to resolve merchant issues, unblock growth, and ensure high-levels of partner satisfaction.
* Adapt your approach based on market dynamics and partner needs to influence the adoption of new features, marketing products, and services.
* Collaborate across operations, marketing, and product teams to share local market knowledge and shape regional strategies that scale.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  
  

* 3+ years of experience in account management, operations, sales or customer-facing functions.
* Ability to negotiate with external partners and overcoming objections to gain commitment.
* Ability to handle high-ambiguity environments and pivot quickly based on shifting business priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to build and leverage data-driven insights for portfolio sales lifecycle-management.
* **Fluency in Mandarin**, and professional proficiency in English.
* High school diploma or equivalent.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  

* Proficiency in Salesforce and Google Sheets/Excel for data-driven decision making.
* Demonstrated problem-solving ability to solve gaps in merchant processes.
* Stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence without authority.

  
For New York City, NY-based roles: The total on-target earnings (OTE) range for this position is USD $99,286 - USD $110,000. The OTE includes a base salary range of USD $69,500 per year - USD $77,000 per year and an annualized cash variable incentive target of USD $29,786 - USD $33,000.

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. jobs.title: Program Operations Associate
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
--------------

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.
  
  
In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

As **Program Operations Associate**, you will own the launch and ongoing operation of Imprint’s partner card programs. You’ll sit on the Solutions & Delivery team and work directly with brand partners and cross-functionally with Growth, Product, Engineering, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Customer Success, and Marketing to get each program launched on time and running well.

This is an execution role first. You’ll manage every workstream from kickoff through GA launch, keep each launch on track, and build the systems that make every launch more repeatable than the last.

**What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days**

* You are fully embedded in a live partner launch and can give a clear status on every workstream at any time: what’s complete, what’s at risk, who owns what, and what comes next
* Cross-functional partners come to you as the source of truth for launch status and next steps
* You drive open items to completion yourself wherever possible, working independently across teams
* You surface risks and dependencies ahead of readiness reviews, so go/no-go decisions have no surprises

**Responsibilities**

* Own execution for assigned partner program launches, managing every cross-functional workstream from kickoff through launch day
* Take on the full range of work each launch requires, such as:

  + Working with Compliance on bank partner reviews
  + Tracking launch workstream status with Growth
  + Gathering requirements with Solutions Engineering
  + Updating product configurations
  + Supporting legal documentation and drafting
* Identify operational gaps that slow launches or adoption, then build lightweight systems and standard playbooks to close them
* Translate product capabilities into clear partner-facing materials and SOPs where launches need them
* Track launch milestones, partner feedback, and internal execution signals, and recommend improvements
* Partner with Growth, Product, Engineering, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Bank Partnerships, Member Operations, and Marketing to launch and operate partner programs

**Qualifications**

*Required*

* 3+ years of experience in strategy, operations, program management, or a similar execution-heavy role at a high-growth startup
* High ownership and hands-on approach. You take on whatever the work requires, from the details to driving decisions, and see it through to completion
* Exceptional project management. You keep many workstreams, owners, and deadlines organized and moving at once
* Strong stakeholder management. You can align multiple teams without formal authority and build trust quickly at any level
* Comfortable in ambiguity, and able to build structure where none exists
* A bias toward processes and systems that scale across programs, with sound judgment on tradeoffs
* Clear communicator who can turn product capabilities into partner value

*Nice to Have*

* Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or embedded financial products
* Experience supporting B2B2C products or partner-led product development
* Familiarity with bank partner and regulatory readiness for card programs

**Perks & Benefits**
--------------------

* Competitive compensation and equity packages
* Leading configured work computers of your choice
* Flexible paid time off
* Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage
* Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA
* 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents
* Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

*Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.*

Compensation Range: $120K - $150K

jobs.description:
**Create the visual storytelling for a city focused design brand.**
===================================================================

**About Us**
------------

We are a product design company with a small team, focused on transit systems and cities.

Our flagship product, Metroboard, is a walnut and aluminum art piece that shows live train movement through the city.

We are especially rooted in New York, where most of our community and customers are, but the work is about cities broadly.

We focus on form through function and the curiosity, recognition, and wonder of seeing something familiar reframed.

**Role overview**
-----------------

This role is for someone with great taste and great video production skills who can turn urban culture into consistent, cool, short-form content.

You will be responsible for creating and posting social content across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, building narrative threads around the product, and shaping how the brand shows up online.

This is a high-output, creative execution role. It requires strong instincts for what resonates and the ability to ship quickly and improve quickly through iteration.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* You will film, edit, and publish short-form video content in New York, often around our product line, city environments, and everyday transit life and stories.
* You will organize and lead media shoots, including directing team members on camera and appear on camera when necessary.
* You will develop recurring content formats, narrative hooks, and visual styles that help our pieces feel contemporary with city and digital life.
* You will engage with comments, messages, and community goings-on online.
* You will collaborate closely with our Creative team to align visuals and storytelling.
* You will travel to other major U.S. cities that we offer Metroboards for such as Boston, Chicago, Washington, D.C., Los Angeles, and San Francisco. In the future, international travel will be required as we expand our offerings.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

* Strong intuition for TikTok, Reels, and internet-native storytelling
* Comfort filming in NYC environments
* Taste for urban aesthetics, design objects, and city life
* Ability to work independently without heavy direction
* Speed, initiative, and consistency in video work
* Willingness to experiment and iterate quickly
* Comfort being on-camera

**Application instructions**
----------------------------

No need for a formal cover letter! Instead, please send:

* A short note on why cities, design, or transit interest you
* A portfolio or 2–4 examples of content you have created

**Benefits & Perks**
--------------------

We've got the basics and then some!

* Fully covered Gold-tier health, vision, and dental insurance (PPO).

* Flexible work structure & unlimited PTO

We are looking for someone who can develop and implement marketing strategies to increase our firm's visibility, strengthen our brand, engage with potential clients, and help expand our presence in the communities we serve.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate will take initiative, propose new marketing ideas, develop advertising campaigns, create engaging content, and actively seek opportunities to introduce our law firm to new audiences and communities.

**Our goal is to build a stronger brand, increase our visibility, and connect with more individuals and families who may benefit from our legal services.**

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit:

jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

**This position is open to candidates with existing work authorization in the location where the position is advertised.**

**Job Overview**

The Digital Marketing Officer will support the execution and delivery of IRC’s digital marketing and fundraising initiatives by managing day-to-day project workflows, coordinating production, and facilitating cross-functional collaboration across teams, in close partnership with senior team members who define campaign strategy and performance goals.

This role serves as a central point of coordination between Online and Offline Acquisition, Retention, Creative Studio, and key stakeholders, ensuring that campaigns, web assets, and digital experiences are delivered on time, on brand, and aligned with performance goals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Management & Production Coordination**

* Manage end-to-end delivery of digital campaigns and web assets (ad copy, creative, video, web imagery, and donation forms)
* Serve as the primary liaison with Creative Studio, managing request intake, conducting initial review and submission of creative assets, and overseeing QA and approval workflows to ensure high-quality output aligned with performance standards and brand guidelines
* Maintain project timelines, workflows, and documentation across multiple concurrent initiatives
* Ensure all deliverables move efficiently from concept through production, QA, and launch
* Maintain campaign tracking tools (e.g., ad trackers) to ensure accurate and up-to-date visibility into campaign status, assets, and timelines

**2. Cross-Team Coordination & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the central intake point for digital production requests across teams, including Acquisition, Retention, and Planned Giving
* Prioritize and balance competing requests to ensure alignment with organizational goals
* Facilitate communication between mass markets, creative, analytics, and technology teams
* Coordinate and distribute regular campaign updates, summaries, and key learnings to stakeholder

**3. Specialized & Cross-Functional Campaign Support**

* Support the execution, launch, and optimization of digital campaigns for specialized initiatives and priority projects (e.g., Planned Giving, Peer-to-Peer, lead generation, or pilot campaigns)
* Monitor and support peer-to-peer platform activity, including tracking new fundraisers and supporting inbound inquiries
* Partner with relevant stakeholders to coordinate the development of landing pages, donation forms, and supporting assets, ensuring adherence to digital best practices and Creative Studio workflows
* Ensure campaigns and assets align with broader digital strategy, donor journey, and cross-channel initiatives
* Support amplification of organic content through paid promotion (e.g., boosting posts) in collaboration with the social media team

**4. Web & Marketing Technology Support**

* Coordinate development of web assets, including landing pages, donation forms, and campaign experiences
* Project manage CRO (conversion rate optimization) tests across donation forms and web assets, and support the Digital Marketing Senior Officer with discovery on web tools, pilots, and digital features
* Implement and optimize Gift-in-Kind ad campaigns, like Google ads and LinkedIn Grant, partnering with internal stakeholders on how to best utilize the budget and achieve results

**5. Quality Assurance & Process Improvement**

* Ensure all assets meet brand, UX, and accessibility standards
* Validate tracking, naming conventions, and campaign setup across platforms
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows, production efficiency, and cross-team collaboration

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Minimum 5 years of equivalent experience
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with attention to detail
* Experience coordinating creative production (copy, design, video)
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
* Familiarity with digital marketing channels and campaign workflows
* Comfort working with web platforms, CMS tools, and basic technical concepts
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills

**Desirable:**

* Experience with project management tools (Monday.com, Jira, etc.)
* Basic understanding of HTML/CSS or web production
* Experience in nonprofit or fundraising marketing

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Development Representative (2)
jobs.description:
*Hey there, it’s Bram, the Director of Sales Development at Carv. I know the application process can often feel impersonal, so I wanted to leave a quick note on why you should consider joining Carv. Besides the fact that we’re an AI company offering a strong SDR salary and great benefits, we’re also an early-stage business.*  
  
*That means things move fast: direction changes constantly, and what you sold today might be obsolete tomorrow. In my eyes, that’s the best environment to truly learn* sales.  
  
At *Carv, SDRs have regular conversations with founders, but also a team and leader (me) dedicated to their success.*

#### **Major Benefits**

* Base Salary is between $65,000 - $75,000 with OTE up to $105,000+
* 100% Medical Coverage
Company trip to Amsterdam coming in December

#### **Carv’s Mission**

Simply to make human recruiting again. AI is a major buzzword, we understand that and while its a very competitive market we think by augmenting recruiters to do more candidate focused work we can fundamentally change the way Recruiting is done by Enterprise level companies.

#### **Day to Day**

For the most part, SDR’s remain the same, Cold Calling, Emailing, Prospecting, LinkedIn - We believe the difference is in the margins, while being consistent and organized are major pluses creativity is essential for an early stage company. Some of our recent initiatives include delivering bagels to local prospects in person, going to trade shows and conferences, sending champagne to new job starters, and soon we will be sending cameo’s to prospects — All of these were SDR driven and you have the same chance to make an impact in this way.

#### **Challenges**

It’s not all roses though, we understand that. We are in a challenging environment, one where AI is EVERYWHERE and we are trying to do one of the toughest things you can do in sales - break into the US market. This job isn’t for the faint of heart but if you can be successful in a bootstrapped startup your value increases dramatically for the future.

#### **Who you are**

Someone with strong business acumen that is quickly able to understand our prospects and the value proposition of Carv. The people who thrive in this role know how to balance their time between structured repetitive tasks and creative initiatives that move the needle with high level enterprise accounts

#### **Additional Benefits**

* Unlimited PTO
* Company Stock Options
* Work laptop
* Personal Development Budget

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
Premier Global Links LLC is recruiting on behalf of a confidential, venture-backed fintech company that recently raised more than $40 million in Series A funding. The company is developing AI-powered solutions that help finance teams improve accounting workflows, financial close processes, and operational efficiency.

We are seeking motivated, articulate Business Development Representatives (BDRs) to build an outbound sales pipeline, engage finance leaders, and support the company's next stage of growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct outbound prospecting through cold calls, email, and LinkedIn to reach CFOs, Controllers, and VPs of Finance.
* Build expertise in an assigned industry segment and develop targeted account strategies.
* Research prospects' finance operations, ERP systems, accounting workflows, and business priorities.
* Generate and qualify sales opportunities, targeting 12–15 qualified meetings per month at full ramp.
* Respond promptly to inbound leads and demo requests.
* Partner with Account Executives to develop account plans, follow up with prospects, and re-engage previous opportunities.
* Maintain accurate prospecting activity and pipeline records in HubSpot.
* Test outreach messaging, improve sales sequences, and share market feedback with sales leadership.

**Required Qualifications**

Candidates should meet **one** of the following experience profiles:

* **Fintech Sales:** 6 months to 2 years of outbound BDR/SDR experience at a fintech company, ideally selling to CFOs, Controllers, or finance teams; or
* **Accounting:** 2–4+ years of experience at a Big Four accounting firm, with a CPA background.

Additional qualifications:

* Strong communication skills, professional phone presence, and the ability to engage senior decision-makers.
* Excellent research, organization, and relationship-building skills.
* A proactive, coachable, and results-oriented approach.
* Willingness to work on-site in New York City.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with fintech, ERP, accounting software, financial close, billing, or spend-management solutions.
* Background in accounting, audit, FP&A, consulting, or client-facing finance.
* Experience prospecting into CFO and Controller organizations.
* Evidence of consistent performance, ownership, and professional development.

**Career Growth**

Join an expanding sales team with direct coaching from experienced sales leaders. High performers may have opportunities to advance into Account Executive positions as the organization grows.

**Interview Process**

The process is expected to include an initial screening, a CEO interview, and a case study.

Premier Global Links LLC is an equal opportunity recruiting firm. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, skills, and business needs.

As the face of NFIB in your local market, you'll meet face-to-face with small business owners, grow membership, and help strengthen the Voice of Small Business. We are hiring an Outside Sales Representative to drive new membership growth through prospecting, area management, and face-to-face sales. This field-based B2B sales role focuses on meeting directly with small business owners, delivering sales presentations, overcoming objections, and enrolling new members.

**What You'll Do**

* Prospect and engage small business owners in your local area
* Build quick rapport and establish trust through face-to-face interactions
* Present NFIB's advocacy mission and membership benefits
* Identify business needs and recommend solutions
* Overcome objections and enroll new members
* Achieve sales goals through prospecting, lead generation, and closing activity
* Represent NFIB as a trusted advocate for small businesses

**This is a hunter/closer role** with a structured sales process, an assumptive one-call close, and no account management after the sale, allowing you to focus on prospecting, selling, and growing membership.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **W-2 Employee Status** with full benefits eligible after 30 days (medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), and more)
* **100% Commission Compensation Plan** with uncapped earning potential
* **Average Annual Earnings: $80,000-$200,000+**
* Up to **13 weeks of performance-based training pay** ($1,000 per week or commissions earned, whichever is greater)
* Weekly commission payments plus monthly and quarterly bonuses
* Monthly mileage reimbursement
* Industry-leading sales training and ongoing professional development
* Flexible, self-directed work environment with significant independence

**What We're Looking For**

Sales experience is helpful but not required. We welcome candidates from sales, fundraising, community outreach, recruiting, education, military leadership, business ownership, and other customer-facing backgrounds.

**We value drive, coachability, resilience, and work ethic over industry-specific experience.**

**Successful candidates are**

* Self-motivated with a strong work ethic and competitive drive
* Resilient, coachable, and professionally persistent
* Strong communicators who build trust quickly
* Comfortable working independently
* Passionate about supporting small businesses and local communities

**Why NFIB?**

NFIB helps shape public policy and strengthen the voice of independent business owners nationwide. For more than 80 years, we have been the Voice of Small Business in Washington D.C., and all 50 state capitals. As a nonprofit, nonpartisan, member-driven organization, **we fight for the rights of independent business owners** to help ensure they have a strong voice in government through advocacy, public awareness, and member engagement.

**Ready to make an impact? Apply today and join the Voice of Small Business**

Equal Opportunity Employer

Outside Sales, B2B Sales, Business Development, Territory Management, Prospecting, Lead Generation, Customer Acquisition, Face-to-Face Selling, Cold Calling, Consultative Selling, Objection Handling, Closing Sales, Pipeline Management, Presentation Skills, Communication Skills, Time Management, Self-Motivation, CRM and Sales Technology, Small Business Advocacy, Prospecting, Lead Generation

Many successful NFIB sales representatives have backgrounds in Outside Sales, Retail Management, Military Service, Small Business Ownership, Fundraising, Community Outreach, Political Campaigns, Education, Insurance, Real Estate, Telecommunications, Door-to-Door Sales, Field Sales, Territory Management

jobs.title: Retail Inventory & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Wolford**

Wolford represents the epitome of luxury and innovation in legwear and bodywear. With a rich heritage of knitting expertise and a global presence, we are committed to delivering exceptional quality, unmatched comfort, and a tailored customer experience. We empower our teams to exceed expectations, foster innovation, and contribute to the growth of a timeless, desirable brand.

**Join the World of Wolford — and help shape our future.**

**Position Overview**
=====================

The Retail Operations Coordinator is based at 609 Madison Avenue and is primarily responsible for the accurate and timely processing of shipments and merchandise movements across Wolford’s New York City boutiques. This hands-on role keeps merchandise organized, accurately recorded, and ready for the sales floor, allowing store leaders and brand ambassadors to focus on clients and selling.

Alongside NYC shipment responsibilities, the coordinator supports inventory accuracy, store standards, and operational processes across all Wolford boutiques in the US through inventory monitoring, process follow-up, and training support. The role partners closely with the Director of Retail, field leaders, and store leaders to identify issues, coordinate corrective actions, and maintain consistent operational standards.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**NYC Shipments and Merchandise Processing**
--------------------------------------------

* Own daily shipment receiving and processing for NYC boutiques, coordinating priorities and time across locations based on delivery volume and business needs.
* Unpack, count, inspect, and verify incoming merchandise against shipment documentation and advance shipping notices (ASNs); complete accurate receiving in NewStore.
* Identify shortages, overages, damages, and other delivery discrepancies; document issues and follow up with the appropriate teams through resolution.
* Prepare merchandise for the sales floor, including required labeling, security tagging, and replenishment, in partnership with store teams.
* Prepare and process outbound shipments, interstore transfers, and other approved merchandise movements, ensuring accurate documentation, system transactions, and shipment tracking.
* Maintain organized, safe receiving and stockroom areas, keeping product accessible and shipment materials cleared promptly.

**Inventory Accuracy and Control Across All US Boutiques**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Monitor open ASNs, negative on-hand balances, and open or aging transfers; follow up with stores to research discrepancies and complete required actions.
* Coordinate and track weekly cycle counts, required recounts, and inventory corrections; support stocktakes and discrepancy research.
* Monitor damage processing and ensure merchandise is documented, handled, and removed from sellable inventory according to company procedures.
* Identify recurring NewStore inventory issues and escalate unresolved discrepancies with clear supporting information.

**Additional Operational Responsibilities**
===========================================

**Store Standards and Operational Support Across All US Boutiques**
-------------------------------------------------------------------

* Support consistent execution of the Operations Manual and maintain best practices for stockroom organization, merchandise care, and inventory handling.
* Review stockroom standards during store visits and partner with store leaders to improve organization and workflow.
* Provide hands-on guidance and operational retraining on receiving, transfers, cycle counts, and related NewStore processes.
* Ensure store teams check returned or handled merchandise before restoring it to sellable stock, following company procedures.

**PR and Special Merchandise Movements**
----------------------------------------

* Coordinate store pulls for PR requests, communicating requirements and tracking product pulls, transfers, shipping, and returns as applicable.
* Support end-of-season transfers to Outlet or E-commerce and other approved special product movements.
* Provide operational assistance to headquarters for PR, damages, or other product handling needs as assigned.

**Qualifications**
==================

* Experience in retail stock, inventory, logistics, or store operations; luxury or specialty retail experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of receiving, transfers, cycle counts, and stockroom organization; NewStore experience preferred.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and follow-through, with the ability to balance shipment deadlines and administrative responsibilities.
* Clear communication skills and confidence supporting and training store teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and inventory or point-of-sale systems.
* Ability to perform the essential physical duties of receiving and moving merchandise, with reasonable accommodation as applicable, and to travel between NYC boutiques; occasional store visits as needed.

*Wolford is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Trustee Liaison
Development Assistant, Trustee Giving and Campaign Operations
jobs.description:
The Museum of Modern Art is currently accepting applications for a Development Assistant who will provide administrative and operational support to the Trustee Giving and Campaign Operations team, with an emphasis on project coordination, accurate data entry, and timely execution. Ensures gifts are processed, acknowledged, and recorded accurately, so the team, trustees, and donors can count on a well-run, responsive operation.

This is an operations-focused role with mostly internal partners. The ideal candidate enjoys independent, detail-oriented work and is professional, responsive, and collaborative.

**Specific responsibilities include:**

**Gift Processing and Acknowledgments**

* Completes gift paperwork and gathers required documentation (checks, letters, etc.) so gifts can be posted. Reviews documentation to ensure gifts are processed and allocated appropriately and that donor expectations are met.
* Updates gift tracking systems for gifts from trustees and committee members, campaign and endowment contributions, and pledge payments. Ensures new pledges and supporting backup documentation are recorded and tracked in a timely manner. Regularly reviews and reconciles records against donor databases to ensure data accuracy.
* Drafts and sends gift acknowledgments and tax acknowledgment letters, ensuring every gift is acknowledged in a timely manner by the appropriate person(s). Maintains records of communications in the CRM and files.

**Data Coordination and Reporting**

* Maintains donor management tracking resources in the customer relationship management (CRM) system, project management tools, and Excel, including gifts and pledges, donor and recognition information, appeals, and stewardship touchpoints.
* Maintains donor and program records and files, and responds to requests for information from other departments.
* Contributes to the development and refinement of CRM-based tracking systems and reports with the Associate Director and Development Officer to improve team efficiency.

jobs.title: Intake & Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the role**  
Achievements ABA Therapy is seeking a family-focused coordinator to guide prospective families through intake and build local referral relationships across Atlanta. This in-person role combines timely inquiry follow-up, intake coordination, accurate records, and community outreach.

**What you’ll do**

* Connect with prospective families by phone, email, and text; explain services and guide them through screening, records collection, insurance review, and assessment coordination.
* Follow up promptly, track each inquiry and next step, and keep accurate lead source, contact, and status records in company systems.
* Gather and organize intake information, identify missing items, and coordinate clear handoffs with clinical, authorization, and operations teammates.

* Help plan outreach activities and share recurring family questions and community needs with the team.
* Protect confidential information and follow company privacy, documentation, and communication procedures.

**What we’re looking for**

* At least one year of experience in customer service, healthcare administration, intake, care coordination, community outreach, or a related role is preferred.
* Warm, clear communication, strong organization and follow-through and comfort managing several inquiries and deadlines at once.
* Comfort with email, calendars, spreadsheets, and web-based record systems, with the ability to learn company platforms and workflows.
* Ability to work in person in the Atlanta area and travel locally for partner visits and events. A valid driver’s license and reliable transportation are required for local travel.
* Flexibility to attend occasional evening or weekend events, scheduled in advance when possible.

**Helpful experience**

* ABA, autism services, behavioral health, or another family-centered healthcare setting; familiarity with Atlanta community partners; or CRM experience.

**Work setting and schedule**  
This is a full-time, in-person position based in the Atlanta area. The role includes local travel and occasional community events outside standard business hours.

**About Achievements ABA Therapy**  
We provide applied behavior analysis services to children and families, helping families understand their options, and coordinate services with care, communication, and respect.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Wine & Spirits Macon and Central Georgia
jobs.description:
Description:

A Real Territory. Real Work. Real Upside.

This is a well-developed territory anchored in Central Georgia's core beverage corridor, stretching from Macon across the region's most active retail and restaurant markets through Warner Robins, Perry, and Dublin. The accounts are real, the portfolio is strong, and the market knows Eagle Rock.

What that means for the right person: you walk into credibility. What it doesn't mean: the work is done. Independent retail buyers and restaurant operators in this market have high expectations. Earning their business takes showing up prepared, knowing your products cold, and proving through consistency that you're worth their time. The rep who does that in this territory will build something worth keeping for a long time.

You'll also have something most reps don't: a Team Leader who built this territory over 20+ years, lives in the market, and brings regional oversight experience to everything you do. That knowledge is available to you. What you do with it is up to you.

Requirements:

**Who We’re Looking For**

The split is roughly 70% independent retail, 30% on-premise. This territory rewards someone who takes both seriously:

? **A Retail Seller Who Gets Independent Buyers -** Package stores and specialty wine shops are the backbone of this territory. You need to understand how independent owners think, what drives their decisions, and how to become the rep they call first.

? **Someone Who Earns Trust the Right Way -** Relationships in this market were built over years. You won't inherit them overnight. What you will have is a foundation and a name people recognize. Turning that into loyalty takes showing up, following through, and knowing your stuff.

? **A Self-Starter -** You own the route from day one. No one is going to build your schedule or tell you where to be. The reps who thrive here are the ones who treat the territory like it belongs to them, because it does.

? **Product Credible -** The buyers in this market know wine and spirits. You need to as well, or you need to be committed to getting there fast. Curiosity and preparation go a long way.

? **Coachable -** A 20-year veteran of this specific market is in your corner. The fastest path to growth in this role is knowing when to ask a question and being sharp enough to apply the answer.

? **Licensed & Road-Ready -** A valid Georgia driver's license and clean driving record are required. You'll be covering meaningful ground across Central Georgia every week.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Run the Territory -** Manage a full book of independent retail and on-premise accounts across Central Georgia. The route is yours. The results are yours.
* **Grow Your Retail Base -** Call on package stores, wine shops, and specialty retailers with consistency and preparation. Find gaps in distribution and fill them.
* **Work the On-Premise Accounts -** Maintain and grow relationships with the region's best restaurants. Secure placements, build by-the-glass programs, and show up as a resource, not just a vendor.
* **Merchandise and Execute -** Manage shelf placement, build displays, and bring promotional programs to life across your account base.
* **Prospect Aggressively -** A developed territory still has room to grow. Identify new accounts, open new doors, and expand Eagle Rock's footprint across the region.
* **Use Your Resources -** You have a Team Leader with 20+ years of market knowledge available to you. Use it. The reps who grow fastest here ask good questions and act on the answers.
* **Collaborate Internally -** Work with operations, logistics, and marketing to deliver clean execution from order to shelf.

**What You Get**

* **Commission-Based Compensation -** No ceiling. The territory has real volume and real upside. What you earn is a direct reflection of what you build.
* **Monthly Vehicle Allowance -** We cover your wheels so you can focus on the road ahead.
* **Full Benefits Package -** Medical, dental, vision, and 401(k).
* **20+ Years of Market Intelligence in Your Corner -** A Team Leader who built this territory from the ground up lives in the market and is available to you. That is a genuine competitive edge.
* **Ongoing Training & Development -** Product education, sales technique, and category expertise. We invest in making you better.
* **Exclusive Industry Access -** Producer visits, trade tastings, portfolio events, and direct access to some of the most respected names in wine and spirits.
* **A Culture That Wins -** We work hard, move fast, and celebrate the people who make it happen. Effort is recognized here and ambition has room to grow.

Physical Requirements

*This role involves hands-on account work including moving cases of wine and spirits, setting up displays, and driving between accounts daily. Must be able to lift up to 70 lbs. You'll work across a variety of environments including retail spaces, restaurants, coolers, and storage areas.*

These tools are to improve efficiency and consistency while supporting more informed hiring decisions, which will ultimately be made by the hiring team.

* Driven, results oriented; performance driven vs. metric driven.

* Skilled at both relationship management and closing ability with customers; ability to flex techniques and style to various audiences.

* Resilient, persistent, and willing to take risks.

* Proficiency using complex sales data/call reporting software/applications.
* Superior selling, technical and relationship building skills.
Proficient with MS Office in a Windows environment and familiar with sales reporting software.

This role requires regular travel and the ability to effectively perform work in a variety of professional environments, including customer sites, healthcare settings, conferences, and company locations. Responsibilities may involve extended periods of driving, standing, walking

VieMed Healthcare is the largest independent specialized provider of non-invasive ventilation (NIV) in the US home respiratory health care industry. We specialize in treating the most challenging respiratory patients inside the home by pairing the best-in-class technology & equipment with the clinical care of a full-time Respiratory Therapist. We are always aiming to be the leading provider in post-acute in-home care with the implementation of palliative services.

Our Disease Management program has earned national attention, making us the number one independent ventilation provider in the United States. In recent random studies of our patient population, we have shown a 30-day COPD re-admission rate of 5.7% compared to the industry average of 20-22%\*. Over 93% of our patients share that they actually “Breathe Better” on our treatment program!

While our Respiratory Therapists provide the highest level of clinical care and support for our patients, our Sales Representatives work in conjunction with healthcare decision-makers to ensure a comfortable transition for the patient from the hospital to their home. This achieves better management of the length of stay and re-admission rates to hospitals, which reduces costs for patients and brings personalized clinical care directly to the patient from the comfort of their own home. Our mission is to educate, nurture, and inspire our patients to lead better lives.

**Position Summary:**

This position is a field-based, business development, hands-on clinical sales position that requires a candidate with the drive and skill to be a patient advocate, and positive representative of VieMed. This position is responsible for identifying & initiating one-on-one dialog with new potential referral sources and maintaining positive relationships with existing referral sources. They will leverage their clinical and sales expertise to design/develop cutting edge sales strategies to drive VieMed’s disease management program and respiratory products to new market potential to grow the business within the assigned territory.

The candidate will spend most of their time (80% or more) in the field: networking, building relationships, and educating referral sources\* within the hospital on all the benefits of VieMed’s disease management program will improve the lives of their patients with Chronic Respiratory Failure. Hospital Referral Sources: Pulmonologist, Hospitalist, Critical Care Physicians, Case Managers, and Social Workers.

Studio Operations & Member Experience

* Greet members and manage class check-ins and check-outs.
* Respond to member calls, emails, voicemails, and inquiries through our booking portal.
* Assist with membership questions, scheduling, and general member support.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and fully stocked reception and retail area.
* Monitor merchandise and studio supply inventory.
* Organize daily member milestone celebrations, birthdays, and special recognition.
* Complete miscellaneous administrative and studio tasks as needed.

Social Media Management & Content Creation

* Manage day-to-day posting on The Lagree Society’s social media accounts.

* Capture and edit engaging photo and video content during studio visits, classes, and events.

* Monitor comments, messages, and engagement, responding or escalating inquiries as appropriate.
* Stay current on social media trends and identify opportunities for growth.
* Track basic social media performance and identify what content resonates with our audience.

Marketing & Community Engagement

* Assist with planning, promoting, and executing studio events, pop-ups, and special Society Sessions.
* Create and distribute promotional flyers, graphics, and marketing materials.
* Identify local partnership opportunities with businesses, wellness brands, and community organizations.
* Develop and execute creative marketing ideas to attract new clients and increase memberships.
* Support membership promotions, referral initiatives, and special campaigns.

Website & Digital Marketing

* Make routine website updates, including promotions, events, schedules, and studio information.
* Assist with basic SEO improvements.
* Create and distribute email newsletters and promotional communications.
* Ensure consistent branding across digital platforms and marketing materials.

Qualifications

* Experience managing social media accounts and creating short-form video content.
* Proficiency with Instagram, Canva, and video editing applications such as CapCut.
* Strong written communication and creative storytelling skills.
* Friendly, dependable, and comfortable interacting with members.
* Organized, detail-oriented, and capable of working independently.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and meet deadlines.
* Experience with Mindbody, Squarespace, or email marketing platforms is a plus.
* Interest in fitness, wellness, and boutique studio culture preferred.

Schedule

* Part-time, approximately 15–20 hours per week.

We’re looking for someone who is equally passionate about people and creativity. Someone who can make our members feel welcome, keep the studio running smoothly, and independently create content that captures the energy and community of The Lagree Society.

**MFS** is spear-heading the **Communities Partnering 4 Peace,** a framework designed to provide comprehensive, long-term approach to reduce violence and gang activity. * Serve as the designated liaison between BHS staff, community partners, and the Information Systems department; submit, track, and escalate help-desk tickets and system requests on behalf of the team and follow through to resolution.

The Pritzker School of Molecular Engineering (UChicago PME) is the first school in the nation dedicated to molecular engineering, and integrates science and engineering to address global challenges from the molecular level up. UChicago PME’s rigorous academic and research programs are enhanced through the University of Chicago’s unique partnership with Argonne and Fermi National Laboratories, and the broad excellence of scholarship and education on campus. **About Copado**

Copado is the leading DevOps platform for Salesforce, revolutionizing how the world's largest organizations achieve success in their Salesforce deployments. * Solid understanding of Git version control concepts, including branching strategies, merge conflict resolution, and repository management in the context of Salesforce delivery

* Familiarity with CI/CD integrations, including Git providers (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket), ALM tools (Jira, Azure DevOps), and pipeline automation via APIs and webhooks

* Strong customer-facing communication skills, with experience managing enterprise or strategic accounts
* Ability to work cross-functionally and thrive in a fast-paced, globally distributed team environment

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager - Automotive
jobs.description:
**Customer Success Manager (Automotive SaaS)**
==============================================

**MOTO(acquire) | Chicago, IL (In Office, Downtown above Union Station) | Full Time | $65,000 to $90,000**

**About MOTO(acquire)**
-----------------------

MOTO(acquire) helps car dealerships buy more used vehicles directly from consumers. Our platform turns a dealer's website, customer database, service drive, and social media into acquisition channels:

* **MOTO(convert):** website trade tool with instant valuations, firm offer requests, and monthly value tracking
* **MOTO(retain):** sends past sales and service customers their vehicle's value every month
* **MOTO(drive):** service drive acquisition that uses DMS data and automated texts to find and buy cars already in the shop
* **MOTO(social):** gives every salesperson and creator their own link, with leads attributed in the CRM

We work with hundreds of dealerships across the country, from single rooftops to large dealer groups, and we're an approved vendor in the Stellantis dealer program. We're a small, fast-moving team, so your work will show up right away in dealer results and in how the company grows.

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring a Customer Success Manager to own the relationship with our dealer partners after the sale. You'll onboard new rooftops, make sure every dealer gets real value from MOTO(acquire), and catch problems before they turn into churn. You'll be the person dealers call when they need help, and the person who calls them first when the numbers say something is off.

You'll report directly to our CEO and work side by side with our sales team and engineers in our Chicago office. You'll also help us build the future of customer success at MOTO(acquire). We're building AI-assisted tools to monitor accounts, queue up outreach, and support dealers at scale, and we want you shaping how they work.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own a book of dealer accounts and keep regular contact with every partner, including GMs, GSMs, used car managers, service directors, and BDC managers
* Build relationships with corporate leadership at dealer groups, including directors of used cars, fixed ops, digital, and operations, and keep MOTO(acquire) running smoothly across all of their rooftops
* Run onboarding and go-live calls for new rooftops: product walkthroughs, settings reviews, customer text reviews, testing, and launch
* Launch and support MOTO(drive) on the service drive, working with dealers to turn service customers into vehicle acquisitions
* Review dealer websites, lead flow, and performance data to spot problems early and suggest improvements
* Run regular performance reviews with dealers and dealer group leadership that show the vehicles, leads, and results MOTO(acquire) is delivering
* Track account health, usage, and customer contacts in HubSpot
* Help design and roll out AI-assisted customer success workflows, from automated account monitoring to AI-drafted dealer outreach
* Troubleshoot issues with dealers and work with our engineering team to get them fixed fast
* Find expansion opportunities (more rooftops, more products) and partner with sales to close them
* Feed what you hear from dealers back to product so we keep building the right things
* Represent MOTO(acquire) at NADA and on occasional visits to larger dealer groups

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

**Must haves**

* 2+ years in customer success, account management, or support at an automotive software company, OR 2+ years working in a car dealership
* Confident on the phone, on video calls, and in person with dealership leadership and dealer group executives
* Organized enough to manage a large book of accounts without anything slipping
* AI-minded: you already use tools like ChatGPT or Claude or Claude Code in your work, and you're excited to build smarter ways to support customers
* Comfortable with technology and quick to learn new tools
* A sense of urgency. Dealers move fast and expect the same from their vendors.
* Able to work in person at our downtown Chicago office five days a week
* Able to travel occasionally for NADA and dealer group visits

**Huge plus**

* Service acquisition experience: service drive equity mining, service-to-sales, or buying cars from service customers
* Experience in used car acquisition, appraisals, or trade-in tools
* Experience working with dealer groups or OEM programs
* Familiarity with dealership systems such as CDK, Reynolds & Reynolds, Dealertrack, Tekion, vAuto, or dealer CRMs
* Experience with HubSpot or another CRM
* Experience building automations, prompts, or workflows with AI tools

**Why MOTO(acquire)**
---------------------

* Report directly to the CEO and have real influence on the product and the company's direction
* Help build an AI-first customer success function from the ground up
* Work with hundreds of dealerships and some of the largest dealer groups in the country
* Unlimited PTO
* Downtown Chicago office above Union Station, easy to reach by Metra, Amtrak, and the CTA

**Compensation**
----------------

$65,000 to $90,000 base salary, depending on experience.

**Location**
------------

222 S. Riverside Plaza, Chicago, IL 60606. This is an in-person role, five days a week.

jobs.description:
***Who we are:***  
bread & Butter is a full-service communications agency with a fondness for all things food, drink and travel. We are a collaborative group of dreamers and do-ers. We combine intimate local knowledge with an extensive national network to craft clever and multidisciplinary communications campaigns tailored to our clients’ needs. We only partner with inventive businesses that inspire us and continually challenge us to think big, but act small.  
  
***Why bread & Butter:***  
We are Southerners at heart, always saying, “Please” and “Thank You,” and hustlers by trade. We believe everyone deserves a seat at the table and practice what we preach to ensure the spirit of hospitality runs through everything we do. We're not a company that wastes time—not yours, not ours. We are not too busy to talk, come by or think of new ways to increase long-term brand awareness. For us, there is little difference between work and pleasure because our work is our pleasure.  
  
***We’re Looking at You!***  
A Social Media Manager with bread & Butter is a digital whiz kid, go-getter, and many-hat wearer who is ready to roll up your sleeves and get to work. You can’t get enough social, whether it’s following the top foodie influencers, keeping up with the latest digital trends or trying the latest TikTok trend. You’re also obsessed with restaurants, wine, food products, destinations and hotels and most likely have been a waiter, front desk clerk, line cook or oenophile in a past life. You are the account dynamo, helping meet client goals by crafting a social media voice and channeling brand sentiment to build authentic, relevant, interactive conversations and relationships. A proverbial eager beaver, you meet or beat deadlines, stay ahead of trends and always look for a new way to skin a cat. You like to go big – because going home isn’t an option. You’re a problem solver, creative thinker and value the relationships you’ve built with influencers and trendsetters. A Social Media Manager for bread & Butter should be thoughtful, creative, a strong writer, possess an almost obsessive attention to detail and is the first to get in the mix when helping means the chance to learn more.  
  
***Available Opportunity:***  
A Social Media Manager for bread & Butter is responsible for managing the online platforms of clients and influencer programming on a daily basis. The Social Media Manager will serve as a representative of the company and works in tandem with the PR, Creative, and Digital Marketing Teams.  
  
***Here’s What We Need:***

* Located in Washington, D.C. or Park City, UT
* 3-5 years of full-time, post-undergraduate relevant experience in social media management and influencer marketing, preferably with agency vs. in-house
* BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience
* Appreciates the art of telling the client story through influencer partnerships and key messaging
* A passion for building and cultivating relationships with influencers in the digital space, ranging from Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube and blog content creators
* Extensive knowledge of Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, YouTube and other relevant social media networks.
* Experience with launching social campaigns for hotels, restaurants, food personalities and/or CPG food and beverage brands.
* Background in creative development, social media analytics tools, and campaign analysis.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, prioritizing and handling multiple projects.
* Ability to peer and self-edit writing quickly, turning around social media posts in real time.
* Ability to identify strategic and creative social media collaborations, takeovers and promotions for brands and lead through steps to execute.
* Help develop and strategize creative influencer partnerships and alliances that keep clients ahead of the curve.
* Ability to exercise sound judgement, responding to consumers and guests within a brand’s voice during daily community management practices.
* Media junkie - there’s no such thing as reading/watching too much. Bonus points for pop culture acumen.
* Love of a fast-paced environment and the satisfaction of a busy yet productive day.
* Flexibility and a desire for endless possibilities. b&B is a dynamic, ever-evolving company that thinks beyond black and white.
* Excitement for growth, new ideas, new ways of doing things and a place you’re excited to call home. Say yes!

  
***Working Conditions***  
On the whole, this is a hybrid, office-based role. A Social Media Manager will spend time in meetings and briefings. Occasional travel might be required for client visits and planning. This position is considered sedentary to light work, and employees are not required to lift or move heavy objects. Although a Social Media Manager's commitment will tend to be standard office hours, deadlines or the demands of a client may see the Manager working nights or weekends to ensure continued success. Must be authorized to work in the US.  
  
***Having Our Cake & Eating it too:***

* Generous paid time off
* Paid sick/personal time
* Birthday off (because who wants to work on their special day!)
* Endless summer Fridays (half-days year 'round baby)
* Flexible, hybrid schedule
* Work from any b&B office when you're in town
* Medical and dental + dependents
* Extended benefits (vision, life, disability, EAP)
* Generous maternity and family planning leave
* 3% contribution to 401k regardless of participation
* Cell phone reimbursement
* New business bonuses
* Employee referral bonus
* Weekly Wine Wednesdays (cheers with your local team!)
* Robust training program
* Mentorship program
* Local love (yearly giveback initiative)

  
***Compensation:***  
The annual salary range for this role is $65,000 to $75,000.

jobs.description:
**What is Exoticca?**

Exoticca is a pioneering online travel agency that has revolutionized the conception, production, and e-commerce of long-distance dream trips. At the core of Exoticca's brand equity is the commitment to "creating life milestones." We believe in delivering best-value trips, exploring unique destinations, curating extraordinary travel experiences, and demonstrating genuine care for both our customers and the planet.  
  
We are a professional, dynamic, multicultural team in rapid international growth, seeking new partners to help us create the best and most forward-thinking travel company of our generation.

**What do we do?**

Our B2B Sales Team is responsible for developing and growing Exoticca's network of Travel Advisors and agency partners across North America. Through a combination of field sales, training, account activation and relationship management, the team helps Travel Advisors discover Exoticca, understand our product and ultimately grow their business with us.

**What will you do?**  
The Sales Representative (B2B) is a field-based sales role focused on developing and growing Exoticca's Tier 2 and Tier 3 agency accounts (Silver & Bronze) within an assigned territory. This is a hands-on, execution-focused position with a strong emphasis on in-person agency visits, account activation and high-frequency market coverage.

You will work closely with the Business Development Managers and the broader B2B Sales Team to ensure that our Silver and Bronze accounts receive regular commercial attention, product education and support, helping them increase their engagement and bookings with Exoticca.

**Your main responsibilities will include:**  

* Visit Travel Agencies regularly across the assigned territory, maintaining a consistent and high-frequency field presence.
* Manage and develop a portfolio primarily composed of Silver and Bronze account (Tier 2 & Tier 3) within Exoticca's Loyalty Program.
* Build strong relationships with Travel Advisors and agency teams, becoming their day-to-day commercial point of contact.
* Activate and grow existing accounts, helping Travel Advisors move from registration to first booking and from occasional to more frequent production.
* Identify opportunities to reactivate dormant and low-producing accounts.
* Educate Travel Advisors on Exoticca's destinations, products, promotions, booking tools and Loyalty Program.
* Conduct in-person product presentations, agency trainings and webinars.
* Identify potential new agency partners and support the acquisition and activation of new accounts.
* Promote group opportunities and identify potential group business within the assigned portfolio.
* Attend relevant trade shows, industry events, conferences and FAM trips when required.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date information on account activity, visits and commercial opportunities in CRM.
* Work closely with Business Development Managers to identify accounts with significant growth potential that may require additional commercial support.
* Meet agreed activity and performance KPIs, including agency visits, account activation, booking activity and portfolio development.

The emphasis on frequent field coverage and a recurring visit pattern is intentional: the Sales Representative role is designed to provide more intensive market coverage than the more senior BDM structure.

 **Requirements**  

* 1–2 years of experience in sales, business development, account management on the travel industry.
* Experience within the travel industry is preferred, but we are also open to candidates with strong sales potential and a genuine interest in travel.
* Strong commercial mindset and enthusiasm for developing customer relationships.
* Comfortable spending a significant amount of time in the field visiting Trave Agencies.
* Self-motivated and comfortable managing a territory and daily visit schedule independently.
* Strong communication, interpersonal and presentation skills.
* Comfortable conducting small group presentations, product training and webinars.
* Organized and disciplined in managing follow-ups and CRM activity.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-changing and international environment.
* Willingness to learn, receive hands-on coaching and develop within the organization.
* Availability to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory and occasionally attend industry events and FAM trips.
* Fluency in Spanish is a plus.

  
**Benefits**  

* Competitive compensation package in line with job responsibilities and experience.
* Travel packages at reduced prices!
* English/Spanish lesson, bi-annual company parties.
* Referral bonus, if you bring people as talented as you.
* And last but not least, becoming part of a fun and motivated multicultural team at an agile and rapid growing organization!

Join Exoticca and play a pivotal role in creating life milestones through unforgettable travel experiences! This is your opportunity to shape the future of a dynamic and innovative travel brand on a global scale.

*Exoticca is an equal opportunity employer. Diversity and inclusiveness are our core. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under European, country, or local law.*

CHC provides a full continuum of services to meet the physical, emotional, educational, vocational, and spiritual well-being of young people.

CHC’s doors are open to youth and staff regardless of their race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. new_jobs.title: Producer / Production Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Great stories start with extraordinary people.**
==================================================

We’re bringing together exceptional creative talent to tell the stories of people shaping the future. Work alongside people who raise your standards, champion your ideas, and give you room to do the best work of your career.

*Story inspires science. Science makes story real.*

**Your Story**
--------------

We're looking for a Junior Producer / Production Coordinator who's organized, resourceful, and hungry to make great films.

Story produces high-end commercial and branded content for some of the world's most ambitious companies, alongside a growing slate of original scripted fiction and nonfiction projects.

You'll work directly with our producers and creative team to bring these productions to life. One day, you might be coordinating crew and logistics for a commercial shoot. The next, you're scouting locations, organizing equipment, or helping pull together a documentary production on a tight deadline.

We're looking for someone who takes initiative, figures things out, and doesn't wait to be told what to do. You're comfortable juggling a dozen moving pieces, solving problems on the fly, and doing whatever it takes to help a production succeed.

This is an opportunity to get hands-on experience across every stage of filmmaking, take on real responsibility, and grow into a producer capable of leading your own projects.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* **Keep productions moving.** Support multiple projects simultaneously, coordinating schedules, logistics, crew, equipment, locations, and travel.
* **Make things happen.** Research locations, source equipment, track down vendors, and find creative solutions to production challenges.
* **Coordinate crews and vendors.** Help book crew, manage communications, coordinate availability, and ensure everyone has the information they need.
* **Stay on top of the details.** Maintain production calendars, call sheets, contact lists, schedules, budgets, and other essential production documents.
* **Support shoots on set.** Help manage day-of logistics, coordinate with crew, and handle unexpected problems to keep productions running smoothly.
* **Track budgets and expenses.** Help prepare estimates, collect invoices, track spending, and keep production finances organized.
* **Support projects from start to finish.** Work with producers and the creative team throughout pre-production, filming, and post-production.
* **Take ownership.** Anticipate what needs to happen next, identify problems early, and take initiative to solve them without waiting for instructions.

**You're the Right Person If**
------------------------------

* You have some experience working in film, commercial production, documentaries, or a related creative production environment.
* You're extremely organized and can keep track of multiple projects, deadlines, and details at once.
* You're resourceful and persistent. When you hit a roadblock, you look for another way forward.
* You're proactive and take ownership of your work. You don't need constant direction to get things done.
* You're a clear communicator who can work confidently with crew, vendors, clients, and creative teams.
* You're comfortable with production tools, spreadsheets, budgets, calendars, and scheduling.
* You're adaptable and happy to jump between planning at a desk and solving problems on set.
* You have a genuine interest in filmmaking and want to understand every part of the production process.
* You're based in the SF Bay Area or willing to relocate.

**What Sets You Apart**
-----------------------

**You're relentlessly resourceful.** You don't give up when something gets difficult. You'll make the extra call, find another option, and keep pushing until you've figured it out.

**You're one step ahead.** You anticipate what needs to happen next and take care of details before anyone has to ask. You make the people around you more effective.

**You're organized under pressure.** You can juggle several projects, respond to last-minute changes, and keep everything moving without losing track of the details.

**You have a get-it-done attitude.** No task is beneath you. Whether it's building a production schedule, tracking down a location contact, or making a last-minute equipment run, you take pride in getting things done right.

**You want to become a great producer.** You're curious, ambitious, and excited to learn from experienced filmmakers. You don't just want to coordinate productions. You want to understand how they're built and lead them yourself.

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.
  
  
In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

You’ll sit on the Solutions & Delivery team and work directly with brand partners and cross-functionally with Growth, Product, Engineering, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Customer Success, and Marketing to get each program launched on time and running well.

  + Gathering requirements with Solutions Engineering
  + Updating product configurations
  + Supporting legal documentation and drafting
* Identify operational gaps that slow launches or adoption, then build lightweight systems and standard playbooks to close them
* Translate product capabilities into clear partner-facing materials and SOPs where launches need them
* Track launch milestones, partner feedback, and internal execution signals, and recommend improvements
* Partner with Growth, Product, Engineering, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Bank Partnerships, Member Operations, and Marketing to launch and operate partner programs

**Qualifications**

*Required*

* 3+ years of experience in strategy, operations, program management, or a similar execution-heavy role at a high-growth startup
* High ownership and hands-on approach. You take on whatever the work requires, from the details to driving decisions, and see it through to completion

Description:

A Real Territory. Real Work. Real Upside.

This is a well-developed territory anchored in Central Georgia's core beverage corridor, stretching from Macon across the region's most active retail and restaurant markets through Warner Robins, Perry, and Dublin. The accounts are real, the portfolio is strong, and the market knows Eagle Rock.

What that means for the right person: you walk into credibility. What it doesn't mean: the work is done. Independent retail buyers and restaurant operators in this market have high expectations. Earning their business takes showing up prepared, knowing your products cold, and proving through consistency that you're worth their time. The rep who does that in this territory will build something worth keeping for a long time.

You'll also have something most reps don't: a Team Leader who built this territory over 20+ years, lives in the market, and brings regional oversight experience to everything you do. That knowledge is available to you. What you do with it is up to you.

Requirements:

**Who We’re Looking For**

The split is roughly 70% independent retail, 30% on-premise. This territory rewards someone who takes both seriously:

? **A Retail Seller Who Gets Independent Buyers -** Package stores and specialty wine shops are the backbone of this territory. You need to understand how independent owners think, what drives their decisions, and how to become the rep they call first.

? **Someone Who Earns Trust the Right Way -** Relationships in this market were built over years. You won't inherit them overnight. What you will have is a foundation and a name people recognize. Turning that into loyalty takes showing up, following through, and knowing your stuff.

? **A Self-Starter -** You own the route from day one. No one is going to build your schedule or tell you where to be. The reps who thrive here are the ones who treat the territory like it belongs to them, because it does.

? **Product Credible -** The buyers in this market know wine and spirits. You need to as well, or you need to be committed to getting there fast. Curiosity and preparation go a long way.

? **Coachable -** A 20-year veteran of this specific market is in your corner. The fastest path to growth in this role is knowing when to ask a question and being sharp enough to apply the answer.

? **Licensed & Road-Ready -** A valid Georgia driver's license and clean driving record are required. You'll be covering meaningful ground across Central Georgia every week.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Run the Territory -** Manage a full book of independent retail and on-premise accounts across Central Georgia. The route is yours. The results are yours.
* **Grow Your Retail Base -** Call on package stores, wine shops, and specialty retailers with consistency and preparation. Find gaps in distribution and fill them.
* **Work the On-Premise Accounts -** Maintain and grow relationships with the region's best restaurants. Secure placements, build by-the-glass programs, and show up as a resource, not just a vendor.
* **Merchandise and Execute -** Manage shelf placement, build displays, and bring promotional programs to life across your account base.
* **Prospect Aggressively -** A developed territory still has room to grow. Identify new accounts, open new doors, and expand Eagle Rock's footprint across the region.
* **Use Your Resources -** You have a Team Leader with 20+ years of market knowledge available to you. Use it. The reps who grow fastest here ask good questions and act on the answers.
* **Collaborate Internally -** Work with operations, logistics, and marketing to deliver clean execution from order to shelf.

**What You Get**

* **Commission-Based Compensation -** No ceiling. The territory has real volume and real upside. What you earn is a direct reflection of what you build.
* **Monthly Vehicle Allowance -** We cover your wheels so you can focus on the road ahead.
* **Full Benefits Package -** Medical, dental, vision, and 401(k).
* **20+ Years of Market Intelligence in Your Corner -** A Team Leader who built this territory from the ground up lives in the market and is available to you. That is a genuine competitive edge.
* **Ongoing Training & Development -** Product education, sales technique, and category expertise. We invest in making you better.
* **Exclusive Industry Access -** Producer visits, trade tastings, portfolio events, and direct access to some of the most respected names in wine and spirits.
* **A Culture That Wins -** We work hard, move fast, and celebrate the people who make it happen. Effort is recognized here and ambition has room to grow.

Physical Requirements

*This role involves hands-on account work including moving cases of wine and spirits, setting up displays, and driving between accounts daily. Must be able to lift up to 70 lbs. You'll work across a variety of environments including retail spaces, restaurants, coolers, and storage areas.*
